short_description: Immerse yourself in Egypt's cultural treasures and marvel at its natural beauty on this all-inclusive 13-day tour. Start in Cairo, visit the Pyramids of Giza, explore Luxor, cruise the Nile, and more.
full_description:
Day 1: Arrival Cairo
Meet-and-greet at Cairo Airport and private transfer to your hotel. Check-in, rest, and overnight stay.

Day 2: Cairo – Giza Pyramids & Egyptian Museum
After breakfast, visit the Great Pyramids of Giza: Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos, marveling at this ancient wonder. Continue to the renowned Egyptian Museum to view priceless artifacts, including the treasures of Tutankhamun. Transfer to Cairo railway station to travel to Luxor

Day 3: Cairo to Luxor – East Bank Tour
Transfer & Pickup from Luxor railway station. Guided tour of Luxor's East Bank visiting Karnak Temple and Luxor Temple.
Embarkation and check-in on your Nile Cruise.
Dinner and overnight aboard the Nile Cruise in Luxor.

Day 4: West Bank Exploration & Cruise to Edfu
Breakfast onboard.
Visit the West Bank of Luxor including the Valley of the Kings, Temple of Hatshepsut, and the Colossi of Memnon.
Lunch served onboard.
Set sail in the afternoon towards Edfu.
Dinner onboard accompanied by evening entertainment.
Overnight stay onboard as you sail towards Edfu.

Day 5: Temples of Edfu & Kom Ombo
After breakfast onboard, tour the Temple of Horus at Edfu. Sail to Kom Ombo to explore the unique temple dedicated to Sobek and Horus. Overnight sailing to Aswan.

Day 6: Aswan Highlights & Optional Abu Simbel
Morning tour of Aswan’s High Dam and beautiful Philae Temple. An optional early-morning trip to the magnificent Abu Simbel Temples is available. Dinner and overnight onboard.

Day 7: Leisure in Aswan & Transfer to Hurghada
Enjoy a relaxing morning in Aswan. Later, a private transfer to Hurghada, arriving in the evening for check-in and rest.

Days 8-10: Relaxation & Optional Activities in Hurghada
Enjoy leisurely days in Hurghada with opportunities for optional excursions, including desert safaris, camel rides, snorkeling, and quad biking. Each evening, overnight stay at your Hurghada hotel.

Day 11: Hurghada to Cairo – Old Cairo & Citadel
Early breakfast followed by a private transfer back to Cairo. Explore historic Old Cairo, including the Saladin Citadel and the splendid Muhammed Ali Mosque. Overnight at your Cairo hotel.

Day 12: Cairo Leisure & Optional Tours
Free day for independent exploration or optional visits to Memphis, Saqqara, or Alexandria. Overnight in Cairo.

Day 13: Departure
Breakfast at your hotel followed by a private transfer to Cairo International Airport for your flight home.

title: Supply Partner |
short_description: Enjoy the beautiful sights of Cairo on a 2-day shore excursion. See the famous pyramids, the Sphinx, Saqqara, and visit the Egyptian Museum. You will spend the night in a luxurious 5-star hotel.
full_description:
Spend a couple of days in Cairo to visit its most beautiful sights. See the famous pyramids at Giza, the Sphinx, Saqqara, and visit the Egyptian Museum. Then, stay overnight in a luxurious 5-star hotel.

Day 1: Ain Sokhna harbor - The Pyramids at Giza

You will be picked up at Ain Sokhna harbor and travel in an air-conditioned car to Cairo to visit the 3 pyramids of Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure, and the gigantic Sphinx. You will take time to explore these architectural masterpieces, then later, go on to visit the oldest tomb complexes in Egypt at Saqqara, site of the step-pyramid of King Zoser. Enjoy a delicious lunch, before driving to the Khan-el-Khalili bazaar, one of the most famous and time-honored bazaars in the Middle East.

Day 2: Egyptian Museum - Citadel - Ain Sokhna harbor

After breakfast you will drive to the Egyptian Museum, where the masterpieces of dynastic period art are displayed, including the treasure of Tutankhamen. You will lunch in a carefully selected restaurant, and afterwards, visit the Saladin Citadel and the Alabaster Mosque of Muhammad Ali.

full_description:
Day 1: Arrival in Cairo
• Meet your representative at Cairo International Airport; they will be waiting for you with a sign FTS Travels.
• Enjoy a comfortable private transfer directly to your hotel in Cairo.

Day 2: Cairo – Nile Cruise in Aswan
• Your driver will pick you up from your hotel and transfer you to Cairo domestic airport for your flight to Aswan.
• Visit the Aswan High Dam, one of Egypt’s greatest engineering feats.
• Check in and enjoy lunch aboard your Nile Cruise. Relax and enjoy the scenic Nile views. Free time onboard to unwind.
• Explore the beautiful Temple of Philae, dedicated to the goddess Isis.

Day 3: Nile Cruise – Kom Ombo Visit – Sailing to Edfu
• Breakfast on board. Sail to Kom Ombo. Visits: Temple of Kom Ombo
• Lunch on Borad
• Sail to Edfu for overnight

Day 4: Edfu Visit in the early morning - Luxor Sailing
• Visit the majestic Temple of Horus in Edfu, one of Egypt's best-preserved temples.
• Sail towards Luxor, enjoying lunch onboard with views of the Nile.
• Upon arrival in Luxor, tour the stunning Luxor Temple.
• Optional activity – experience the captivating Sound & Light Show at Karnak Temple (available at additional cost).

Day 5: Luxor – Flight back to Cairo
• Guided visit to Karnak Temple, the famous Valley of the Kings, where you'll explore tombs of ancient Egyptian pharaohs.
• Continue to the impressive Temple of Queen Hatshepsut at Deir El-Bahari.
• Transfer to Luxor Airport for your return flight to Cairo.
• Upon arrival in Cairo, transfer and check-in to your hotel.

Day 6: Cairo Highlights & Departure
• Visit the renowned Egyptian Museum of Antiquities, home to extensive collections of artifacts.
• Explore the iconic Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx.
• Transfer provided to Cairo International Airport in time for your departure flight.

full_description:
Avoid waiting in line or queue by pre-booking your tickets to the Abu Simbel Temple.
The Abu Simbel Temples, located south of Aswan on the shores of Lake Nasser, are among Egypt’s most iconic sites, second only to the Great Pyramids of Giza. Built by Pharaoh Ramesses II, these magnificent rock-cut temples, also known as the Temples of Ramesses II, marked the southern boundary of the Egyptian Empire with Nubia during the height of its power in the New Kingdom.

Designed to showcase the might of Egypt's rulers, the temples were a powerful statement to all who beheld them. The four colossal statues guarding the entrance to the larger temple are the largest surviving sculptures from the ancient Pharaonic era.

These twin temples stand as enduring monuments to Ramesses II and his beloved queen, Nefertari, while also commemorating his triumph at the Battle of Kadesh. Their grandeur and historical significance make Abu Simbel a must-visit destination for anyone exploring Egypt’s ancient wonders.

Make sure to obtain the QR tickets from your supplier one day before your visit. Please be aware that the QR GetYourGuide confirmation only serves as a booking confirmation and cannot be used as an entrance ticket. Your supplier will send you another QR ticket, authorized by the Ministry of Tourism, one day before your visit. If you happen to book on the same day, our supplier will contact you directly to send the tickets as soon as possible.
On the day of your visit, it may be necessary to go through a security check before entering the museum. Present your QR code to the staff, who will then scan it to grant you access. If someone informs you that your ticket is not valid, contact your supplier immediately and do not make any additional payments.

short_description: This tour offers a perfect blend of historical exploration, cultural immersion, and a touch of adventure, making it an ideal trip for anyone visiting Cairo.
full_description:
Begin your adventure with a convenient pick-up from your hotel in Cairo. An air-conditioned vehicle ensures a comfortable ride as you head towards one of the most iconic historical sites in the world.

Once you arrive Your guide will provide a fascinating overview of the three main pyramids: the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, and the Pyramid of Menkaure. Learn about the history, construction, and significance of these ancient wonders.
Capture stunning photos of the pyramids from various angles, including the panoramic viewpoint which offers a breathtaking view of all three pyramids together.

Take in the grandeur of the Sphinx up close, marveling at its massive scale and intricate details.it enigmatic monument with the body of a lion and the head of a pharaoh, believed to represent Pharaoh Khafre. Your guide will share intriguing stories and theories about its origins and purpose.

Enjoy a traditional camel ride around the Giza Plateau. This experience not only offers a unique perspective of the pyramids but also immerses you in the age-old tradition of camel riding in the desert. Your guide will accompany you, sharing insights and ensuring your comfort throughout the ride.

After the tour, savor a delicious lunch at a nearby restaurant. Enjoy traditional Egyptian dishes, offering a taste of local flavors and hospitality. After lunch, you'll be driven back to your hotel in Cairo.

short_description: Top Rated Tour with Quality Cover Giza pyramids and Sphinx Hotel pick up and drop off are included Camel Ride for 30 Minutes Shooting some pictures for your trip Best Qualified Guide leading the Trip
full_description:
Your private guide will meet you in the lobby of your hotel in Cairo to begin your unforgettable journey.
Start your tour with a visit to the iconic Pyramids of Giza — the ancient wonders of Cheops (Khufu), Chephren (Khafre), and Mykerinus. These majestic structures are the last remaining wonders of the ancient world and a testament to Egypt's rich history.

Learn about the fascinating history and significance of each pyramid as your guide shares captivating stories from the past.

Next, enjoy a scenic 15-minute camel ride across the golden sands of the desert. This authentic experience offers incredible photo opportunities with the pyramids as a breathtaking backdrop.

Continue your tour with a stop at the Great Sphinx, the mysterious statue with a pharaoh’s head and a lion’s body, standing guard over the Giza plateau. Then, explore the Valley Temple of Chephren, a beautifully preserved mortuary temple believed to have been used in the mummification process.

After the tour, relax and enjoy a delicious lunch at a VIP local restaurant, where you’ll savor traditional Egyptian cuisine in a comfortable setting.

Finally, your guide will escort you back to your hotel in Cairo, marking the end of a memorable half-day tour.

short_description: Admire the sunset across Aswan during private boat cruise along the famous River Nile. Admire the sights of the Aswan skyline, Elephantine Island and Aga Khan Mausoleum, then enjoy a romantic stroll through the Botanical Gardens.
full_description:
Your River Nile adventure begins with pickup from your Aswan hotel in the late afternoon. Head down towards the river then hop on board your private boat for the evening and set sail along the infamous waters of the Nile.

Arrive at the first stop of the tour, the Botanical Gardens on Lord Kitchener Island, home to an array of plants that were imported from all over the wold in the 1800s. Enjoy some free time to stroll around the gardens, admiring the majestic palm trees that line the walkways including the Sabal Palm and Phonic Palm as well as Ficus trees and other beautiful bougainvillea trees.

Head back to the boat and continue along the Nile, watching the sunset and the sky change color. Sail around Elephantine Island, a tiny island home to ancient ruins and temples, then glide past the Mausoleum of Aga Khan built in the style of the Fatimid tombs in Cairo.

full_description:
Begin your premium private Cairo experience with a smooth hotel pickup in a modern, air-conditioned vehicle. Accompanied by your personal Egyptologist guide, you'll enjoy a day of rich history and personalized service.

Start at the iconic Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square, where skip-the-line entry lets you dive right into the heart of ancient Egypt. Discover over 100,000 artifacts, including the breathtaking golden mask of King Tutankhamun, his royal sarcophagi, and countless treasures of the pharaonic era.

Next, journey to the legendary Giza Plateau, where your tickets include access to the Great Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure. Stand in awe before the majestic Sphinx, explore the Valley Temple, and enjoy time for photos or an optional camel ride with panoramic views.

Along the way, stop at a local bazaar or papyrus institute, where you can browse authentic crafts and support Egyptian artisans.

Conclude your tour with a flavorful Egyptian lunch at a carefully selected local restaurant, known for its quality and traditional atmosphere. Throughout the day, your guide and driver will ensure a seamless and unforgettable journey—this is Cairo at its most intimate, enriching, and effortless.

full_description:
Enjoy 4 nights in a private room at El Tahrir Hostel, located in Tahrir Square, Downtown Cairo—just 100 meters from the Egyptian Museum. This budget-friendly stay includes breakfast, Wi-Fi, bottled water, and essential amenities.

Day 1: Arrival in Cairo + Orientation Walk & Koshary Lunch**
- Optional airport pickup (can be added at checkout)
- Check-in and settle into your room
- Enjoy a traditional koshary lunch at a local spot
- Evening guided walking tour in Downtown Cairo
- Explore local streets, hidden gems, and food spots

Day 2: Giza Pyramids, Sphinx & Panorama Point**
- Morning guided visit to the Giza Plateau (Pyramids of Giza)
- See the Sphinx and Valley Temple
- Optional camel ride to the panoramic viewpoint
- Free time in the evening to explore or rest

Day 3: Egyptian Museum & Coptic Cairo**
- Guided tour of the Egyptian Museum (entry included)
- Afternoon visit to Coptic Cairo: Hanging Church & Ben Ezra Synagogue
- Optional Nile boat ride at sunset (not included)

Day 4: Islamic Cairo & Khan El Khalili Bazaar**
- Explore the Citadel of Saladin & Mohamed Ali Mosque
- Bazaar tour through Khan El Khalili
- Tea stop at El Fishawy Café, one of Cairo’s oldest

Day 5: Check-Out & Departure**
- Breakfast at the hostel
- Optional airport transfer available upon request
- Assistance with onward travel if needed

short_description: Embark on an 11-day tour of Egypt and experience a blend of history, culture, relaxation and adventure. See the pyramids, visit the Egyptian Museum, cruise the Nile, relax on the shores of Hurghada, take an overnight train ride, and more.
full_description:
Day 1: Arrive in Cairo
Explore Cairo with ease: Be guided from the airport and to your hotel.

Day 2: Giza Pyramids, Memphis and Saqqara
Start your day in Cairo with breakfast at your hotel. Meet your private guide who will take you to the Giza Plateau to see the Great Pyramid of Cheops and Mykerinus - the famous Sphinx. Explore the enigmatic Step-Djoser Pyramid at Sakkara.

Day 3: Egyptian Museum & Old Cairo
Visit the Egyptian Museum with your private guide. After lunch, visit a local restaurant. Continue to Coptic Cairo to visit the Hanging Church and then to Islamic Cairo. Explore Khan El Khalili, Cairo's old bazaar. Travel from Cairo to Aswan by train.

Day 4: Arrival in Aswan - Sightseeing in Aswan
Upon arrival at Aswan train station, you will be transferred to the Nile Cruise where you will have lunch on board. After lunch, cruise along the Nile and visit the High Dam before arriving at the Temple of Philae. After the tour, return to your boat and spend the night in Aswan at your leisure.

Day 5: Sail to Kom Ombo - Sail to Edfu & Overnight
Breakfast on board your ship. Then join your guide for a visit to one of the temples at Kom Ombo. Then enjoy lunch on the sundeck and sail to Edfu. Admire the scenery of the Nile Valley. Arrive in Edfu for dinner and entertainment and overnight on board the cruise in Edfu.

Day 6: Edfu Visit - Sail to Luxor & Overnight
After breakfast on your Nile cruise, ride the horse carriage to visit the Temple of Edfu. Back on board the Nile cruise, cross Esna lock - the best part of your Egypt travel. Sail to Luxor. Visit the east bank of Luxor including the Karnak temples. You’ll have free time in Luxor to explore the city and have dinner and overnight on board your Nile cruise.

Day 7: Luxor West Bank - Disembarkation
Have breakfast before disembarking. Visit the West Bank of Luxor to see the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon. This tour will end at 14.00 PM. Transfer to Hurghada and check in. Optional: Spend 45 minutes with a hot air balloon company in Luxor.

Day 8, 9, 10 and 11: Relax in Hurghada
You'll have a full day to unwind in Hurghada, Egypt's premier beach resort on the Red Sea. Relax and take advantage of the resort's amenities. You have the opportunity to choose from the add-ons some of our excursions in Hurghada with great offers.

On the last day you will have breakfast at the hotel before checking out. Then travel to Hurghada airport to take a flight (1 hour). Then take your international flight in Cairo back to your country.

full_description:
Unveil the Magic of the Nile: 4-Day Cruise from Cairo to Luxor
Set sail on an unforgettable 4-day Nile adventure with all meals included. Fly from Cairo to Aswan, uncover ancient wonders with an expert Egyptologist, and cruise the river in luxury, stopping at majestic temples and hidden tombs along the way.

Day 1: Cairo to Aswan – Cruise Begins
Pickup from your hotel in Cairo and flight to Aswan.

Visit the impressive High Dam and the enchanting Philae Temple, dedicated to Isis.

Board your 5-star cruise, enjoy lunch and dinner onboard, and relax as the journey begins.

Day 2: Kom Ombo & Optional Abu Simbel
Breakfast onboard as you sail toward Kom Ombo.

Explore the twin temple of Sobek and Horus.

Choose an optional morning tour to the awe-inspiring Abu Simbel Temples.

Sail to Edfu while enjoying lunch and stunning sunset views.

Day 3: Edfu to Luxor – Temples Along the Way
Visit Edfu’s Temple of Horus by traditional horse carriage after breakfast.

Continue sailing to Luxor with meals served onboard.

Enjoy a peaceful evening as the ship docks in Luxor.

Day 4: Luxor's Wonders & Return to Cairo
Take an optional hot air balloon ride over Luxor at sunrise.

Explore the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Colossi of Memnon, and Karnak Temple with your guide.

Transfer to Luxor Airport and fly back to Cairo. Drop-off at your hotel included.

Cruise Features & Entertainment
Luxurious 5-star ship with 62 cabins & 4 suites

Buffet restaurant, bar, and a rooftop terrace with a pool

Evening entertainment including an Oriental party with belly dancing, a themed costume night, and a felucca sailing trip around Elephantine Island

Experience Egypt’s history, beauty, and culture like never before — all from the comfort of your Nile cruise.

short_description: By planning ahead and using online QR tickets, you'll enjoy a seamless and enriching visit to the Citadel of Salah El Din and the Mohamed Ali Mosque in Cairo.
full_description:
Avoid waiting in line or queue by pre-booking your tickets to the Citadel of Salah El Din and the Mohamed Ali Mosque in Cairo. Ensure to obtain your supplier's QR tickets one day before your visit.

The Citadel of Sultan Salah al-Din al-Ayyubi (Saladin) is one of Islamic Cairo’s most iconic landmarks and a remarkable example of medieval military architecture. Strategically perched on the Muqattam Hills, the Citadel offered an unparalleled defensive position and continues to provide breathtaking panoramic views of Cairo.

Construction of the fortress began in 1176 AD (572 AH) under the orders of Sultan Salah al-Din al-Ayyubi but was completed during the reign of Sultan al-Kamel ibn al-Adel in 1207 AD (604 AH). Sultan al-Kamel made it the official residence of Egypt's rulers, a role it maintained until the mid-19th century when Khedive Ismail relocated the official residence to Abdeen Palace in downtown Cairo.

The Citadel has witnessed pivotal moments in Egypt’s history, from its construction through the era of the Muhammad Ali Dynasty, which ended with the 1952 revolution and the birth of the modern Egyptian republic. Over the centuries, various rulers added significant structures, making the Citadel a must-visit destination. Key attractions include the stunning Mosque of Muhammad Ali Pasha, which dominates the skyline, the Mamluk-era Mosque of al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun, and the Ottoman-era Sulayman Pasha al-Khadim Mosque. Visitors can also explore fascinating museums such as the Police Museum, Al-Jawhara Palace Museum, and the Military Museum.

Please be aware that the QR GetYourGuide confirmation only serves as a booking confirmation and cannot be used as an entrance ticket. Your supplier will send you another QR ticket, authorized by the Ministry of Tourism, one day before your visit. If you happen to book on the same day, our supplier will contact you directly to send the tickets as soon as possible.

Note:Opening Hours

Saturday to Friday
9:00 AM > 5:00 PM (Daily)
Last Ticket Admission: 3:00 PM

short_description: From Pyramids to Temples: Uncover the Secrets of Ancient Egypt on a 12-Day Adventure. Get organic oils and scarves from FTS.
full_description:
Day 1: Arrival in Cairo - Welcome to Egypt
You will meet your Tour Manager in the airport, then he will transfer you to the hotel in Cairo and you have the option to see the sound and light show in the evening or not, as you want.
Day 2: Giza Pyramids and Sakkara
Take your breakfast and begin your exploration. First, visit Sakkara, home to the Step Pyramid of King Djoser and the Teti Pyramid. Then, head to the Giza Plateau to see the iconic Great Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure, as well as the enigmatic Sphinx and the Valley Temple.
Day 3: Fly Cairo to Luxor - Nile Cruise
Flight from Cairo to Luxor to take a Nile cruise adventure. Discovering the Beauty of Hieroglyphics at Karnak Temple. Luxor Temple: A Timeless Symbol of Devotion and Majesty. Experience the Mesmerizing Karnak and Luxor Temples Sound and Light Show in Luxor
Day 4: Luxor Nile Cruise Excursions
Journey to the West Bank of the Nile. Explore the Colossi of Memnon, the terraced Temple of Queen Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahri, and the Valley of the Kings, where you'll have the chance to visit three tombs (exact tombs may vary). Intricate Detailing and Vibrant Colors in Ancient Rock-Cut Tombs. The cruise continues as you sail to Edfu via the Esna Lock
Day 5: Kom Ombo and Edfu Temples
Discover the Fascinating Kom Ombo Temple on Your Nile Cruise: A Unique Blend of Crocodile and Falcon Gods
Day 6: Aswan Nile Cruise Tours
Aswan Highlights: Unwind and Explore the High Dam, Unfinished Obelisk, and Philae Temple
Day 7: Aswan to Abu Simbel - Lake Nasser Cruise
Set Sail on a Luxurious Lake Nasser Cruise After Exploring Abu Simbel
Day 8: Lake Nasser Cruise Tours
Sail to Kasr Ibrim, where you'll view the impressive Kasr Ibrim Fortress from the sun deck. Continue to Amada, where you'll visit the Temple of Amada, Ed Deir, and the Tomb of Pennut. Your cruise continues as you sail to Wadi El Seboua
Day 9: Lake Nasser Cruise Tours
Explore Wadi El Seboua in the morning and enjoy a camel ride or a walk to El Dakka and Mehraka. Return to the ship for a relaxing evening as you sail to Aswan
Day 10: Lake Nasser Cruise - Fly to Cairo
Visit Kalabsha Temple and Beit el Wali, exploring the Nubian style Temple of Goddess Hathor. After breakfast, disembark from your Lake Nasser cruise and transfer to Aswan Airport for your flight back to Cairo. Check in to your Cairo hotel and enjoy some free time
Day 11: Cairo Sightseeing – Departure
On your last day in Cairo, visit the renowned Egyptian Museum to explore its extensive collection of artifacts spanning Egypt's history. Discover the Christian heritage in Coptic Cairo, including the Hanging Church and Basilica Church. Spend the afternoon shopping at Khan El Khalili Bazaar before departing for the airport for your international flight home
Day 12: Departure from Cairo
After breakfast at your Cairo hotel, you will be transferred to Cairo International Airport for your departure flight.

short_description: Explore Saqqara’s Step Pyramid, Memphis ruins, Giza Pyramids, Sphinx & Valley Temple. Learn from an expert Egyptologist on a private Cairo tour filled with ancient history and smooth transport.
full_description:
Discover Egypt's Timeless Treasures on a Private Full-Day Tour from Cairo

Start your day with a comfortable pickup from your accommodation in Cairo or Giza. Begin your journey at Saqqara, home to the Step Pyramid of Djoser, the world’s first large-scale stone structure, built around 2630 BC for King Djoser. Marvel at this architectural wonder that laid the foundation for all future pyramids.

Continue to Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt after the unification of Upper and Lower Egypt in 3100 BC. Explore its fascinating open-air museum and see the Colossal Statue of Ramesses II, a breathtaking symbol of ancient Egyptian grandeur.

Afterward, enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant before heading to the iconic Giza Plateau. Stand before the majestic Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinus, and learn about their history and significance from your expert Egyptologist guide.

Then, get up close to the legendary Great Sphinx, a mythical limestone statue with the body of a lion and the face of a Pharaoh. Visit the Valley Temple, where priests performed the mummification rituals, and take in the remarkable ancient architecture.

You’ll also have free time for shopping stops, where you can browse local handicrafts and souvenirs, with the opportunity to negotiate directly with the vendors.

At the end of your experience, relax on the return transfer back to your accommodation in Cairo or Giza, with memories of Egypt’s ancient wonders etched in your mind.

short_description: Discover artifacts from the tomb of Tutankhamun and uncover an wealth of treasures from the past with this skip-the-line ticket to the Egyptian Museum of Antiquities in Cairo.
full_description:
Avoid waiting in line or queue by pre-booking your tickets to the Egyptian Museum.
Make sure to obtain the QR tickets from your supplier one day before your visit. Please be aware that the QR GetYourGuide confirmation only serves as a booking confirmation and cannot be used as an entrance ticket. Your supplier will send you another QR ticket, authorized by the Ministry of Tourism, one day before your visit. If you happen to book on the same day, our supplier will contact you directly to send the tickets as soon as possible.
On the day of your visit, it may be necessary to go through a security check before entering the museum. Present your QR code to the staff, who will then scan it to grant you access. If someone informs you that your ticket is not valid, contact your supplier immediately and do not make any additional payments.
The museum's collection includes over 120,000 items, featuring ancient Egyptian artifacts, statues, jewelry, mummies, papyrus scrolls, and an exceptional array of treasures from the tomb of Tutankhamun. One of the most iconic highlights of the museum is the collection of artifacts from the tomb of King Tutankhamun. This includes the famous golden death mask, thrones, jewelry, and numerous other items that were discovered in the young pharaoh's tomb.

short_description: Discover Cairo’s ancient wonders on a private guided tour. Visit the Egyptian Museum, explore the Giza Pyramids and Sphinx, and enjoy an authentic lunch at a handpicked local restaurant.
full_description:
Experience the best of Cairo on a personalized full-day adventure.
Begin your journey with a private pickup from your hotel in Cairo or Giza. Your expert guide will lead you through the incredible exhibits of the Egyptian Museum, home to millennia-old treasures, royal artifacts, and the famous golden mask of King Tutankhamun.
Next, head to the legendary Giza Plateau to witness one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Stand before the towering Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure, gaze up at the mysterious Sphinx, and walk through the Valley Temple, where kings were prepared for eternity.
Enhance your visit with an optional camel ride across the sands, a fun and scenic way to admire the pyramids from a different angle.
Before heading back, savor a traditional Egyptian lunch at a trusted local restaurant, selected for its flavor and hospitality.
Throughout the tour, you’ll travel in comfort with private transportation, enjoy chilled bottled water and a soft drink, and benefit from the insights of your dedicated Egyptologist guide.
This is Cairo, crafted just for you—seamless, enriching, and unforgettable.

full_description:
Discover the Legacy of Al-Hakim Mosque & Cairo’s Timeless Faiths

Embark on a guided journey through Cairo’s spiritual heart. Begin your tour at the historic Al-Hakim Mosque, one of the city’s oldest and most iconic Islamic landmarks, where your expert guide will introduce you to its 10th-century Fatimid architecture, rich heritage, and serene ambiance.

Then continue to explore the diverse religious tapestry of Cairo:

The Ben Ezra Synagogue, a beautifully preserved Jewish temple with deep historical roots and connections to Egypt’s Jewish community.

The Hanging Church (El Muallaqa), one of the oldest and most famous Coptic churches in Egypt, built atop the Roman fortress of Babylon.

The Mosque of Amr Ibn Al-As, the first mosque ever built in Egypt and Africa, symbolizing the arrival of Islam in the region.

Each stop reveals a unique layer of Cairo’s spiritual and architectural history, guided by expert insights that bring these monuments to life. By the end of the tour, you’ll gain a deeper appreciation for the city’s religious harmony and the remarkable stories etched into its walls.

short_description: Explore Cairo's history with a guided tour of the Mosque of Amr ibn al-As, the first mosque in Egypt, and learn about its cultural and architectural significance.
full_description:
Join us on a captivating guided tour to the Mosque of Amr ibn al-As, the first mosque ever built in Egypt, located in the heart of Cairo. Your journey begins with a pickup from your hotel, where you'll be transferred to the mosque in an air-conditioned vehicle. Upon arrival, your expert guide will introduce you to the rich history and significance of the mosque, which was constructed in 641 AD by the companion of the Prophet Muhammad, Amr ibn al-As.

As you explore the mosque, you'll learn about its architectural evolution, which blends both Islamic and Coptic elements. The mosque's stunning courtyards and prayer halls offer a serene atmosphere, perfect for reflection. The guide will take you through the historical context of the mosque’s establishment, explaining its role in the spread of Islam in Egypt and its connection to Cairo’s development.

After the mosque visit, you'll have the opportunity to walk around the surrounding area, where you'll see a blend of Islamic Cairo's traditional markets and local life. Enjoy the chance to ask your guide about the city’s history and the mosque's influence over time.

This enriching experience provides a deep insight into Cairo's Islamic heritage, leaving you with memories of one of Egypt's oldest and most significant religious sites. Whether you're a history enthusiast or a first-time visitor, this tour offers a unique opportunity to connect with Cairo’s Islamic past.

short_description: Explore Cairo’s vibrant Khan El Khalili bazaar and the historic treasures of Old Cairo with a private guide, round-trip transfers, and immersive cultural experiences.
full_description:
Step into the heart of Cairo’s history and culture on this private guided tour of Khan El Khalili and Old Cairo.

Your journey begins with a comfortable hotel pick-up, taking you first to Old Cairo—home to some of Egypt’s most treasured landmarks. Stroll through the narrow streets to visit the Hanging Church, Abu Serga Church, and Ben Ezra Synagogue, each steeped in centuries of history and faith. Your expert guide will share captivating stories about the area’s Christian, Jewish, and Islamic heritage.

Next, immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Khan El Khalili, Cairo’s most famous market. Wander among colorful stalls brimming with brassware, handmade jewelry, perfumes, spices, textiles, and souvenirs. Test your bargaining skills and enjoy the unique charm of one of the oldest bazaars in the Middle East.

At the end of the day, relax on your transfer back to your hotel, taking with you unforgettable memories and perhaps a few special treasures.

1. The Pyramids and the Sphinx: one of the greatest wonders of the ancient world, alongside the Sphinx.( You can choose the option to be able to disembark in the Giza Pyramids area, move between the pyramids, learn about the ancient Pharaonic civilization, and then ride the helicopter again and complete the rest of the trip.)
2. The Nile River: The world's longest river, extending across Egypt, it offers breathtaking natural views and opportunities for boat trips.
3. Cairo Tower: A television tower providing spectacular views of the city.
4. Tahrir Square: A large central square in Cairo, known for its historical events.
5. The Grand Egyptian Museum: Housing an extensive collection of Pharaonic and ancient Egyptian artifacts.
6. Tahya Misr Bridge: A modern bridge crossing the Nile River, considered a prominent feature in Cairo.
7. The Citadel: A historic in Cairo containing several museums and historic sites.
8. Mosque of Sayyida Aisha: A historical mosque dating back to the medieval period by its traditional Islamic architecture.
9. The Old Egyptian Museum: an impressive collection of ancient artifacts and manuscripts.
10. Mosque and Madrasa of Sultan Hassan: A historic medieval mosque
11. Al-Azhar Park: near Al-Azhar Mosque, offering a peaceful spot for relaxation.
12. Al-Tetsh Stadium: A football stadium in Cairo used for various sporting events.

short_description: the museum has displayed about 4,500 artefacts, it houses more than 100,000 objects. The collection includes rare manuscripts of the Qur'an, with some calligraphy written in silver ink.
full_description:
Our representative will pick you up from your accommodation in Cairo to visit The Museum of Islamic Art, Avoid waiting in line by purchasing your tickets in advance.

The Museum of Islamic Art (MIA) in Cairo, Egypt is considered one of the greatest in the world, with its exceptional collection of rare woodwork and plaster artefacts, as well as metal, ceramic, glass, crystal, and textile objects of all periods, from all over the Islamic world. In recent years, the museum has displayed about 4,500 artefacts in 25 Halls ,[1] but it houses more than 100,000 objects, with the remainder in storage. After the cruise, your driver will be waiting to take you back to your hotel, if you've selected the transportation option.

short_description: Embark on a unique and immersive culinary experience by making your own Feteer Meshaltet, a traditional Egyptian layered pastry, in the serene and rustic atmosphere of a farm in Cairo.
full_description:
Your experience begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel in Cairo. Our friendly and professional representative will meet you at the arranged time, ensuring a smooth and comfortable journey to the farm. Sabah Farm is located in the Orabi division, making it a convenient escape from the bustling city of Cairo. The farm spans 8 feddans (approximately 8.3 acres), divided into two sections:
Enjoying Your Meal Breakfast: Freshly made Feteer Meshaltet: Serve it plain or with a variety of traditional toppings such as white cheese, honey, and molasses. Baladi Bread: A staple in Egyptian cuisine, freshly baked and perfect for dipping. Cheese and Honey: A selection of local cheeses paired with both white and black honey.
Optional Traditional Lunch: If you prefer lunch, the farm offers a hearty Egyptian meal, which may include: Main Dishes: Choose from creamy steak, akaawi (slow-cooked oxtail), stuffed grape leaves (wara' enab), pigeon (hamam), half a duck, or mandi (a traditional dish of rice and meat) Sides: Accompanied by molokhia soup, keshk (a savory yogurt and flour-based dish), and aish baladi Beverages and Dessert: Finish your meal with traditional Egyptian tea and fresh fruit.
The farm may offer additional recreational activities such as bike riding, playing traditional games like chess or Snakes and Ladders, or simply relaxing in one of the cozy huts scattered around the property.
After a day of cooking, eating, and relaxing, you’ll be transferred back to your hotel in Cairo, with a full belly and fond memories of your authentic Egyptian culinary adventure.

full_description:
Day 1: Giza, Sakkara, Dahshur - Camel Ride - Lunch
Your day begins with a visit to the remarkable Giza Necropolis, where you'll explore the Giza Pyramids, including the iconic Great Pyramid, and marvel at the enigmatic Sphinx. Next, venture to Saqqara, where you'll delve into the Step Pyramid and uncover the secrets of ancient tombs. Your exploration continues at the Pyramids of Dahshur, where the Red Pyramid and the Bent Pyramid, Egypt's oldest, await your admiration. Your day is filled with historical wonders, and a delicious lunch will keep you energized for the journey ahead.

Day 2: Egyptian Museum, Citadel, Alabaster Mosque, Khan El Khalili
Kickstart your second day with a visit to the Egyptian Museum, where a two-hour guided tour will introduce you to the world's most extraordinary artifacts and relics from ancient Egypt. Following that, you'll explore the stunning Mosque of Muhammad Ali, an architectural gem within the Citadel of Cairo, and admire the city from its vantage point. Dive into the rich history of Coptic Cairo, visiting its historical sites. The day concludes with a shopping adventure at Khan El-Khalili, guided by an expert who will lead you through its vibrant and bustling alleys.

Day 3: Bibliotheca Alexandrina, Pompey's Pillar, Qaitbay Fortress, Catacombs
On your final day, you'll venture to Alexandria, a city steeped in history and culture. Begin with a visit to the Bibliotheca Alexandrina, a modern marvel and homage to the ancient Library of Alexandria. Explore the impressive Citadel of Qaitbay, a historic fortress that offers breathtaking views of the Mediterranean. Admire the towering Pompey's Pillar, a testament to the city's ancient past. The day concludes with a visit to the Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa, an underground wonder where you can discover intricate tombs and fascinating history.

short_description: Travel from Cairo to Luxor overnight by sleeper train. See the West & East Bank highlights with a private Egyptologist. Choose a 2-day trip with hotel stay or a 1-day express return the same night.
full_description:
Leave Cairo in the evening on the sleeper train and wake up beside the Nile in Luxor—ancient Thebes. With your private Egyptologist guide, you’ll cover the greatest hits on both banks: the painted royal tombs in the Valley of the Kings, the dramatic terraces of Hatshepsut Temple, the iconic Colossi of Memnon, and the monumental complexes of Karnak and Luxor Temple connected by the Avenue of Sphinxes.
Pick the pace that suits you:

Option A — 2-Day Luxor Stay (Sleeper Round Trip)
Best for: easier pacing, a free evening in Luxor, and time for extras.

Day 0 (Evening): Private pick-up → board sleeper (~20:00). Dinner onboard.

Day 1: Arrive Luxor ~06:00. West Bank: Valley of the Kings (3 tombs), Hatshepsut Temple, Colossi of Memnon. Lunch break. East Bank: Karnak (Great Hypostyle Hall, Sacred Lake) & Luxor Temple (golden hour if timing allows). Hotel check-in (4★, BB). Optional Karnak Sound & Light.

Day 2: Optional sunrise hot-air balloon (weather-dependent) or extra sights (e.g., Deir el-Medina / Medinet Habu) as time allows. Evening sleeper back to Cairo. Breakfast served onboard next morning → private drop-off.

Option B — 1-Day Luxor Express (Sleeper In & Sleeper Back Same Evening)
Best for: doing the must-see classics in one efficient day.

Day 0 (Evening): Private pick-up → board sleeper (~20:00). Dinner onboard.

Day 1: Arrive ~06:00. West Bank: Valley of the Kings (3 tombs), Hatshepsut Temple, Colossi of Memnon. Lunch break. East Bank: Karnak & Luxor Temple. Evening transfer to station → sleeper train back to Cairo. Arrive early next morning → private drop-off.

What you’ll see (both options):

Vivid wall art and hieroglyphs inside Valley of the Kings tombs (selection varies).

The cliff-backed terraces of Hatshepsut Temple and photo stop at the Colossi of Memnon.

The pylons, courts, and the Great Hypostyle Hall at Karnak; the elegant courts of Luxor Temple and a glimpse of the Avenue of Sphinxes.

Nile corniche views, curated souvenir stops on request, and comfortable A/C transfers between sites.

short_description: Enjoy a private tour to the Sahara Desert at sunset with a ride on an Arabian horse or camel. Sip Egyptian tea at a Bedouin camp and take in the breathtaking views of the Pyramids of Giza.
full_description:
A typical tour that includes the Sahara Pyramids, an Arab horse or camel ride, and a Bedouin tea experience might look like this:

Early morning pickup from your hotel in Cairo. Visit the Great Pyramid of Giza, the Pyramid of Khafre, the Pyramid of Menkaure, and the Sphinx. A knowledgeable guide will provide insights into the history and significance of these ancient structures.

After exploring the pyramids, head to the stables or camel station. Choose between an Arab horse or a camel for your ride or both
Embark on a guided ride around the pyramids and the surrounding desert. The ride typically lasts between half or one hour. Enjoy the majestic views of the pyramids from different perspectives and take plenty of photos.

Conclude your ride at a traditional Bedouin tent or a shaded area for relaxation.
Enjoy a refreshing cup of Bedouin tea, typically a blend of black tea with aromatic herbs like mint or sage. Learn about Bedouin culture and traditions from your guide.

short_description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to the iconic Pyramids and timeless Sphinx. Feel the thrill as you ride across the desert on a quad bike, with an optional camel safari for extra adventure.
full_description:
Your tour will begin with a pickup from your hotel in Cairo by a professional tour guide, who will transfer you to the Giza Plateau. There, you will discover the awe-inspiring Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos, and enjoy an up-close view of the legendary Sphinx — the guardian statue with a lion’s body and the head of King Chephren, standing proudly beside the ancient funerary complex.

After exploring the pyramids, continue your adventure with a thrilling quad biking ride in the Sahara Desert, just outside the Giza area. Here, you’ll speed across the golden sands, taking in stunning desert views with the pyramids visible in the distance, rather than riding directly beside them. For a more traditional experience, you can choose to add a camel ride — a slower, serene journey offering a timeless perspective of this iconic landscape.

Once your adventure is complete, you’ll be comfortably transferred back to your hotel, carrying memories of a truly unforgettable day in Cairo.

short_description: From Aswan: Cruise the Nile for 3 nights in 5★ luxury with full board and a private guide. Dive into ancient wonders along the way—with an optional tour to the stunning Abu Simbel temples.
full_description:
From Aswan: 4-Day 5★ Nile Cruise to Luxor with Guide & Optional Abu Simbel

Embark on an unforgettable 4-day Nile cruise from Aswan to Luxor aboard a luxurious 5-star ship. Discover the wonders of ancient Egypt with your private Egyptologist guide, enjoy full-board meals, and choose to add an optional visit to the magnificent Abu Simbel temples.

Day 1 – Aswan & Philae Temple
Your journey begins in the charming city of Aswan. After hotel pickup, your guide will accompany you to explore Philae Temple, often called the Pearl of Egypt. Nestled on an island, its graceful colonnades and Graeco-Roman structures rise majestically above the Nile.

After the visit, head to your cruise ship. Enjoy lunch onboard and relax as the ship prepares to sail.

Day 2 – Optional Abu Simbel & Kom Ombo
Start the day with a choice:

Optional Abu Simbel Tour: Visit Ramses II’s awe-inspiring temple, a masterpiece carved into rock and relocated in modern times to escape flooding.

Or enjoy a relaxing morning onboard.

After lunch, the cruise sails to Kom Ombo, where you’ll visit the unique double temple dedicated to Sobek, the crocodile god, and Horus, the falcon god. Marvel at its symmetrical design, with two identical sections for each deity.

Return to the ship for dinner and sail overnight to Edfu.

Day 3 – Edfu & Horus Temple
After breakfast, head with your guide to Horus Temple in Edfu—the best-preserved temple in Egypt and a hidden treasure. Dedicated to the falcon-headed god, it’s filled with incredible carvings and insights into ancient rituals and beliefs during the Greco-Roman period.

Enjoy lunch onboard and continue sailing toward Luxor.

Day 4 – Luxor: West & East Bank
After breakfast, check out and leave your bags at reception as you begin a full day exploring Luxor’s legendary landmarks:

Valley of the Kings: Enter royal tombs of pharaohs and see their vivid wall reliefs that tell stories of the afterlife.

Temple of Queen Hatshepsut: Admire its grand architecture, built in harmony with the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari.

Colossi of Memnon: Snap a photo at these iconic statues guarding the West Bank.

Stop for lunch at a local restaurant, then cross to the East Bank:

Karnak Temple: Walk among colossal columns and ancient sanctuaries built over 1,500 years.

Luxor Temple: Discover its rich history from Amenhotep III to Alexander the Great, once a central part of the Opet Festival.

At the end of the day, your driver will drop you off at your hotel in Luxor.

short_description: The Coptic Museum, inaugurated in 1910, boasts the world’s largest collection of Coptic artifacts. Avoid waiting in line by purchasing your tickets in advance
full_description:
Reserve your tickets in advance through an authorized supplier. This helps you bypass the queues at the entrance.
The Coptic Museum, inaugurated in 1910, boasts the world’s largest collection of Coptic artifacts. Founded through the efforts of Marcus Simaika Pasha, a prominent figure dedicated to preserving Coptic heritage, the museum's establishment was fueled by his passion for collecting antiquities and architectural elements from older churches undergoing restoration.

The museum’s collection spans the history of Coptic Christianity, from its origins in Egypt to its rise as a major center of Christianity. Coptic Christianity traces its beginnings to Saint Mark’s visit to Alexandria in the 1st century A.D. The artifacts on display reflect a fascinating blend of Coptic art with Pharaonic, Greek, Roman, Byzantine, and Ottoman influences, showcasing the evolution of a distinct Coptic identity.

Visitors can explore intricately decorated manuscripts, religious icons, finely carved woodwork, and beautifully painted frescos recovered from ancient churches and monasteries, offering a unique glimpse into the rich history and artistry of Coptic culture.

Be aware that the QR GetYourGuide confirmation is only a booking confirmation. It cannot be used as an entrance ticket. You need a separate QR ticket from your supplier to gain entry.

Note: Opening Hours (Daily 9:00 AM > 5:00 PM )
Last Ticket Admission: 4:00 PM

Throughout your tour, your expert Egyptologist guide will bring history to life with stories, facts, and legends from the time of the pharaohs. Enjoy a traditional Egyptian lunch at a local restaurant before returning to your hotel with unforgettable memories and stunning photos from one of the world’s most iconic destinations.

Next, continue to the world-famous Blue Hole, one of Dahab’s most iconic snorkeling spots. Slip into the crystal-clear waters, where vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish create an underwater paradise — a must-see for snorkel lovers.

Experience the thrill of a camel ride along Dahab’s coastline, taking in the golden sands, turquoise waters, and peaceful desert backdrop.

For extra adventure, you can choose an optional quad bike ride across the desert dunes — the perfect add-on for thrill-seekers!

After a day of exploration, enjoy a delicious BBQ lunch at the beach camp, surrounded by stunning views of the sea and mountains. Take a moment to breathe in the fresh air before embarking on a camel ride along the coast, capturing memorable photos along the way.

Before returning to your hotel, enjoy a stop in the charming town of Dahab, where you can shop for souvenirs, explore local markets, and experience the warm hospitality of the Bedouin community.

This tour combines adventure, relaxation, and authentic culture, offering the perfect day of discovery in Dahab

short_description: A day tour from Cairo to the Chatby Tombs in Alexandria offers a fascinating glimpse into Egypt's Hellenistic period. This day tour will also allow you to explore other key attractions in Alexandria.
full_description:
You will be picked up early in the morning from your hotel in Cairo by a private, air-conditioned vehicle. The drive to Alexandria typically takes about 2.5 to 3 hours. Enjoy the views of the Nile Delta and listen to commentary from your guide about the history and significance of the regions you pass through.
Start your tour with a visit to the Chatby Tombs, one of the oldest necropolises in Alexandria. The Chatby Tombs are significant for their architectural style, which combines Greek and Egyptian elements. The tombs date back to the Ptolemaic period and offer insight into the funerary practices and art of that era. Your guide will explain the significance of these tombs, their connection to the Greek settlers in Alexandria, and how they reflect the blending of cultures during the Hellenistic period.
Enjoy a traditional Egyptian lunch at a local restaurant, sampling some of Alexandria’s renowned dishes or other Mediterranean specialties.
Conclude your tour with a visit to the modern Library of Alexandria, a tribute to the ancient Library of Alexandria. The library serves as a cultural and educational center, featuring striking architecture, various exhibitions, and a vast collection of books and manuscripts.
After a full day of exploration, you'll begin your journey back to Cairo.
Arrival in Cairo: You will be dropped off at your hotel in the evening, marking the end of your day tour.

The tombs date back to the Ptolemaic period and offer insight into the funerary practices and art of that era. Your guide will explain the significance of these tombs, their connection to the Greek settlers in Alexandria, and how they reflect the blending of cultures during the Hellenistic period.
Enjoy a traditional Egyptian lunch at a local restaurant, sampling some of Alexandria’s renowned dishes or other Mediterranean specialties.
Conclude your tour with a visit to the modern Library of Alexandria, a tribute to the ancient Library of Alexandria. The library serves as a cultural and educational center, featuring striking architecture, various exhibitions, and a vast collection of books and manuscripts.
After a full day of exploration, you'll begin your journey back to Cairo.
Arrival in Cairo: You will be dropped off at your hotel in the evening, marking the end of your day tour.

short_description: Discover Citadel of Qaitbay (also known as Fort Qaitbey) in Alexandria is a fantastic way to explore one of Egypt’s most iconic historical landmarks this skip-the-line ticket in Alexandria.
full_description:
To avoid waiting in line, it's advisable to pre-book your tickets to the Citadel of Qaitbay (Fort Qaitbey). Ensure you obtain the QR tickets from your supplier one day before your visit. Please note that the QR GetYourGuide confirmation is only a booking confirmation and cannot be used for entrance. Your supplier will send you a separate QR ticket, authorized by the Ministry of Tourism, a day before your visit. If you book on the same day, the supplier will contact you directly to send the tickets as soon as possible.
On the day of your visit, be prepared for a security check before entering the Citadel. Present your QR code to the staff, who will scan it to grant access. If informed that your ticket is invalid, contact your supplier immediately and do not make any additional payments.
The Citadel of Qaitbay, built by Sultan Al-Ashraf Sayf al-Din Qaitbay in 1477 AD, was designed to protect the city from invading Ottoman forces. Constructed using stones from the ruins of the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria, the citadel is a prime example of Islamic military architecture, featuring thick walls, multiple towers, and a strategic position offering panoramic views over the Mediterranean Sea.
highlights: Get your QR tickets from the supplier one day before the trip
Visiting the Citadel of Qaitbay offers a unique blend of history,
making it a must-see attraction during your trip to Alexandria

short_description: This tour is perfect for those who want to mix adventure with relaxation, combining the luxury of El Gouna’s lagoons with an exciting dive in the Red Sea.
full_description:
This experience is a popular excursion that combines the beauty of El Gouna's lagoon with the opportunity to dive or snorkel with dolphins in their natural habitat. The trip often starts with a leisurely boat cruise through the picturesque lagoons of El Gouna, a man-made lagoon town known for its luxurious resorts, beautiful water channels, and vibrant marine life. You’ll get to explore the tranquil, turquoise waters, enjoy the scenic views of the surrounding villas and hotels, and observe wildlife that inhabits the lagoon area.

The tour will take you to popular diving or snorkeling sites in the Red Sea near El Gouna, where dolphins are known to frequent. These sites are rich with colorful coral reefs and marine life, offering stunning underwater views.

One of the highlights is the chance to dive or snorkel alongside wild dolphins. While it's never guaranteed, these dolphins are often spotted in this area, and many excursions bring you to known spots where dolphin sightings are common.
You’ll either snorkel or dive, depending on your preference and experience level, to see the dolphins swimming in their natural habitat. All necessary snorkeling or diving gear (fins, masks, wetsuits) is usually provided, along with experienced guides who ensure your safety and enjoyment during the diving experience.

short_description: Discover the magic of Cairo in one day: Visit the Pyramids, Egyptian Museum, and Khan El Khalili bazaar. Enjoy expert guiding, a local lunch, and a soft drink—all with private transport.
full_description:
Start your unforgettable day in Cairo with a private pickup from your hotel in a modern air-conditioned vehicle. Meet your professional Egyptologist guide who will accompany you on a historical journey through the wonders of ancient and modern Cairo.

Begin at the iconic Giza Plateau, where you’ll stand in awe before the Great Pyramid of Khufu, explore the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, and marvel at the mysterious Sphinx and Valley Temple. Your guide will share the secrets, history, and symbolism behind these timeless structures.

Next, enjoy an authentic Egyptian lunch at a handpicked local restaurant, with a variety of delicious traditional dishes and one soft drink included.

After lunch, head to the Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square, home to one of the world’s most significant collections of ancient artifacts, including the golden treasures of Tutankhamun and royal mummies.

End the day with a stroll through the historic Khan El Khalili bazaar, Cairo’s oldest and most vibrant marketplace. Discover handcrafted souvenirs, spices, perfumes, silver, and more while soaking in the sights, sounds, and scents of Old Cairo.

This private tour is fully customizable, designed for comfort, cultural immersion, and maximum enjoyment.

Next, enjoy an authentic Egyptian lunch at a handpicked local restaurant, with a variety of delicious traditional dishes and one soft drink included.

After lunch, head to the Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square, home to one of the world’s most significant collections of ancient artifacts, including the golden treasures of Tutankhamun and royal mummies.

End the day with a stroll through the historic Khan El Khalili bazaar, Cairo’s oldest and most vibrant marketplace. Discover handcrafted souvenirs, spices, perfumes, silver, and more while soaking in the sights, sounds, and scents of Old Cairo.

This private tour is fully customizable, designed for comfort, cultural immersion, and maximum enjoyment.

short_description: Discover Luxor and Aswan highlights and see the Abu Simbel temples while exploring Upper Egypt on a private 2-day tour from Hurghada. Enrich your trip with an Egyptologist guide.
full_description:
Experience the wonder of ancient Egypt on this two-day private tour of Luxor and Abu Simbel. See the most spectacular monuments of the past and learn about the history with your Egyptologist guide.

Start in the morning with pickup from your hotel in Hurghada and enjoy a transfer in a private air-conditioned vehicle. Arrive at Luxor to meet your Egyptologist guide and start your adventure.

Explore the final resting place of the Egyptian rulers from the 18th to the 20th dynasty

Continue to the magnificent Hatshepsut temple and see one of the most beautiful and best-preserved ancient Egyptian temples. Next, visit the Colossi of Memnon and see the two colossal stone statues of King Amenhotep III.

After, enjoy a delicious lunch in a restaurant with breathtaking views of the Nile. Make one more stop at the Great Karnak temple, the largest temple complex ever built.

After a long day, relax on a scenic drive to Aswan. Here, check in and unwind in a luxurious 5-star hotel.

On day two, rejoin your guide and enjoy a tour of the two temples of Abu Simbel. Immerse yourself in Ancient Egyptian Civilization as your Egyptologist guide explains the fascinating history behind each archeological site.

When the day is over, ride back in comfort to your hotel in Hurghada.

short_description: Discover the archaeological sites of Abydos and Dendera on a private day trip from Hurghada. See the pharaohs of ancient Egypt. Learn more about the cult of Osiris.
full_description:
Be picked up from your hotel in Hurghada and relax as you drive to the Abydos Temple. Find out why this was once considered one of the holiest places on earth. Explore the cult Osiris and learn more about the gateway to the underworld. 
Admire the Seti Temple with its filigree reliefs, which are among the best in the New Kingdom.Discover Osireion Bath , it is an impressive building with a watery nature in its inception, as it was established on ancient underground water springs and is located behind the Temple of Seti I at a low level of 18 meters.
Listen to your knowledgeable guide tell you more about the legendary rulers, as well as pharaohs who should probably be forgotten.
Continue to the monument of Osireion, which was built in honor of Osiris. Hear about the most powerful man in the Egyptian Empire. Drive to Dendera Temple to see one of the best preserved temples in Egypt. See the last temple built in Greco-Roman times.
Marvel at decorations from Roman rulers alongside Egyptian gods at a temple dedicated to Hathor, the goddess of love, joy, happiness, and music. See a beautiful sculpture of Queen Cleopatra VII.

full_description:
Embark on a full-day guided tour from Hurghada to Cairo by plane, exploring Egypt's iconic landmarks with the expertise of an Egyptologist guide. Available daily, with a special offer every Monday and Thursday for small groups with excellent availability.

Upon arrival in Cairo, you'll be welcomed by your guide and begin your adventure in Giza, visiting the awe-inspiring Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos, along with the legendary Sphinx. The tour also includes a visit to the Valley Temple.

Afterward, enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant. For an added touch, take an optional Felucca boat ride across the Nile. Continue your journey to the world-renowned Egyptian Museum, where you’ll admire over 120,000 masterpieces, including the treasures of Tutankhamun.

Conclude your day with a shopping experience at the vibrant Khan el-Khalili market before returning to the airport for your flight back to Hurghada. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred directly to your hotel. This tour offers an unforgettable glimpse into Cairo's rich history and culture, all in one day.

Start your adventure at the magnificent Karnak Temple, strolling along its spectacular Avenue of Sphinxes. Marvel at the imposing columns, intricate hieroglyphs, and awe-inspiring architecture as your guide shares fascinating insights into Egypt’s rich history.

Next, cross the Nile River by boat from the East Bank to the West Bank ( Optional
), taking in scenic views of the legendary river. Once there, explore the renowned Valley of the Kings, where Egypt’s greatest pharaohs were laid to rest, including a chance to view the vibrant tomb paintings and hieroglyphs.

Visit the stunning Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, dedicated to Egypt’s iconic female Pharaoh, notable for its unique terraces and vividly preserved artwork. Afterwards, stop by the Colossi of Memnon—two towering statues guarding the ancient entrance to Amenhotep III’s temple complex.

Enjoy a delicious buffet lunch at a local Luxor restaurant, refueling before continuing your exploration. Throughout the day, you'll be provided with breakfast snacks, cold drinks, and water to keep refreshed and energized.

End your memorable journey with a comfortable ride back to your hotel, enriched by an unforgettable glimpse into Egypt’s majestic past

short_description: Travel from Hurghada to Cairo for an unforgettable day! Visit the awe-inspiring Pyramids of Giza, meet the enigmatic Sphinx, and discover priceless artifacts in the Egyptian Museum with a local guide.
full_description:
Experience an unforgettable full-day adventure from Hurghada to Cairo in the comfort of an air-conditioned van. Begin your day with an early morning pickup from your hotel and enjoy a scenic drive across the vast Egyptian desert as the golden sunrise welcomes your journey to Egypt’s legendary capital.

Your first destination is the iconic Giza Plateau—home to the world-famous Pyramids of Giza, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Stand before the awe-inspiring Great Pyramid of Khufu, explore the neighboring pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, and capture once-in-a-lifetime photos of these ancient marvels.

Continue your exploration with a visit to the Great Sphinx, the mysterious monument with the body of a lion and the face of a pharaoh. As you walk among these timeless wonders, your professional Egyptologist guide will share fascinating insights into the rich history, myths, and legends of ancient Egypt.

After the pyramid complex, enjoy a delicious lunch at a carefully selected local restaurant—featuring stunning views of either the Nile River or the pyramids, depending on availability. Refreshed and ready, you’ll then head to the Egyptian Museum, home to one of the world’s most impressive collections of ancient artifacts. Marvel at over 120,000 exhibits, including the dazzling treasures of King Tutankhamun, ancient mummies, and countless relics from Egypt’s pharaonic past.

You’ll also have the option to enjoy a peaceful boat ride along the Nile River—an enchanting way to see Cairo from a new perspective.

Wrap up your day with a drive through historic Tahrir Square, and if time allows, browse a local bazaar for traditional souvenirs and local crafts. Finally, sit back and relax as you return to Hurghada in the evening, carrying unforgettable memories of one of the world’s greatest civilizations.

Depart from Cairo and head back to Sharm El Sheikh in the van. Enjoy the scenic views during the return journey.

short_description: Fly from Sharm to Cairo for a day tour. Explore the Pyramids, Sphinx, and Egyptian Museum, then head over to Khan El Khalili to discover local oil products and scarves.
full_description:
Tick off some of Cairo’s most celebrated attractions on this guided trip from Sharm El Sheikh. With round-trip hotel transfers and flights, skip the hassle of planning and focus on enjoying the sights. Available every day with a small group and good availability.
View the Pyramid of Giza and Valley Temple. Devote the afternoon to the Egyptian Museum and Khan el-Khalili bazaar.

Meet the tour representative at your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh for a transfer to Sharm El Sheikh Airport. Catch a flight to Cairo and be greeted by another representative at the Cairo Airport.

Follow your Egyptologist guide to the Great Pyramid of Giza (if add-on selected), the only existing wonder of the 7 wonders of the ancient world.
At the Giza plateau, see the great pyramid of Khufu, known as Cheops, and also the pyramid of Chefren, the pyramid of Mykerinus, the valley temple of Khefren, and the iconic Great Sphinx. This amazing complex of structures dates back to almost 5,000 years ago.

From there, be taken to the Museum of Egyptian Antiquities, which houses around 150,000 artifacts that date back thousands of years to ancient Egyptian civilization.
This is considered the largest and most precious collection of Egyptian art in the world. Take your chance to admire the incredible treasures of the boy-king Tutankhamun.

After the museum, have the chance to wander in the oldest bazaar in the Middle East, the Khan El Khalili Bazaar, where you can feel the atmosphere of living in Islamic Cairo hundreds of years ago.
The bazaar dates back to 1382 A.D. and is just one of the fascinating places we will see, giving you a real taste of the ancient city of Cairo.

At the end of the day, be transferred to Cairo Airport for a flight back to Sharm El Sheikh.
highlights: Available daily with special offers on Tuesdays and Fridays!
Explore the Great Pyramids, Sphinx, and Valley Temple at Giza.
Visit the iconic Egyptian Museum and marvel at Tutankhamun's treasures.

short_description: Join a day trip from Sharm El Sheikh to the Colored Canyon, Blue Hole, and Dahab. Explore vibrant rock formations, snorkel in colorful reefs, and enjoy a delicious BBQ lunch in a Bedouin tent
full_description:
Discover two stunning wonders of the Sinai Peninsula in one exhilarating day on our jeep tour to the Colored Canyon and Blue Hole National Park, departing from Sharm El Sheikh. This unforgettable adventure begins with an early morning pickup in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle, taking you on a scenic journey to the charming town of Dahab.

First, embark on a jeep ride to the iconic Colored Canyon. Wander through a mesmerizing 800-meter gorge filled with vibrant sandstone cliffs displaying shades of yellow, purple, red, and gold. This natural labyrinth promises breathtaking views at every turn.

Next, visit the serene Blue Hole National Park, where you can relax on the beach and experience exceptional snorkeling among an array of colorful coral reefs and marine life. Dive into an underwater paradise teeming with vibrant fish and unique species.

After a day of exploration, enjoy a delicious BBQ lunch at the beach camp, surrounded by stunning views of the sea and mountains. Take a moment to breathe in the fresh air before embarking on a camel ride along the coast, capturing memorable photos along the way.

Your adventure continues with an adrenaline-pumping quad bike ride along Dahab's coastline. Feel the rush as you navigate the scenic terrain, making the most of your time in this beautiful region.

Finally, return by jeep to Dahab City for a brief shopping stop, where you can pick up unique souvenirs before concluding your tour back in Sharm El Sheikh. Join us for a day of natural beauty, adventure, and unforgettable memories!

title: Supply Partner |
short_description: Discover the ancient city of Petra on a day tour from Sharm El Sheikh. Visit the treasury of Al Khazneh, the Roman Theater, and the graves in the King Wall.
full_description:
Start with pickup from Sharm El Sheikh and travel through the Sinai Peninsula to Taba. From here, take a ferry across the Gulf of Aqaba to Jordan. Make your way to the gorge of Ma'an, where the ancient city of Petra can be found.

A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the New Wonders of the World, the city was once described as being "forgotten by the world for over 1,000 years". Petra is home to towering buildings carved into the pink stone. On your tour of the canyon, admire the sight of the Treasure Palace, the Roman Theater, and the Temple and Treasures of the Citadel. One of the most astounding archaeological sites in the world, this tour will allow you to check it off your bucket list.

After exploring Petra, enjoy lunch in a local restaurant before heading back to Sharm El Sheikh.
highlights: Marvel at the archaeological wonder and UNESCO World Heritage Site of Petra
Visit the treasury of Al Khazneh, the Roman theater, and the 13 graves of the famous King Wall
Enjoy a delicious lunch after your explorations

short_description: Private Cairo tour with your guide: visit the Egyptian Museum, see the Pyramids and Sphinx, and enjoy a tasty traditional Egyptian lunch on your journey
full_description:
Begin your private Cairo adventure with hassle-free hotel pickup in a modern, air-conditioned vehicle. Accompanied by your personal Egyptologist guide, enjoy a full day of expert insights and tailored service.

Start at the Egyptian Museum in El-Tahrir Square. With skip-the-line access, head straight into the world of ancient Egypt. Discover over 100,000 artifacts, including the treasures of King Tutankhamun, his golden mask, and royal sarcophagi.

short_description: A full-day Cairo tour for ladies only with a certified female guide. Visit the Pyramids, Museum & Bazaar. Includes hotel pickup and a free camel ride. Optional photo session by a female photographer.
full_description:
Explore Cairo with confidence and comfort on this ladies-only private tour, guided by a professional female Egyptologist. Your experience begins with hotel pickup in Cairo or Giza and a journey to the legendary Giza Pyramids.

Get close to the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos while learning their stories from a guide who understands your pace and preferences. Then enjoy a free camel ride through the desert—a fun and memorable moment, perfect for photos.

Next, explore the world-famous Egyptian Museum, home to treasures like the golden mask of Tutankhamun, royal jewelry, and ancient statues of powerful queens.

Finally, head to Khan El Khalili Bazaar, where you can shop handmade souvenirs, spices, silver, and traditional crafts. Take a break at a local café and soak in the authentic atmosphere of Old Cairo.

Want to capture your day? You can add a professional photo session by a female photographer for stylish, comfortable memories. This tour is ideal for solo travelers, mother-daughter trips, or women looking for a culturally rich, worry-free day in Cairo.

After your gastronomic experience, take some time to explore the area around the Pyramids Lounge and capture memorable photos of the pyramids from different vantage points. Finally, your driver will escort you back to your hotel, concluding your unforgettable day trip to Giza

short_description: Experience Hurghada charm on a private city tour! Explore iconic landmarks, vibrant markets, and stunning coastal views, ending with a delicious seafood lunch.
full_description:
Your adventure begins with a convenient hotel pickup in a private, air-conditioned vehicle. Your expert local guide will accompany you throughout the tour, sharing fascinating insights about Hurghada’s history and daily life.

Start your tour with a visit to the Hurghada Marina, a modern waterfront promenade lined with luxury yachts, restaurants, and cafés. Capture the beauty of the Red Sea and enjoy a relaxing stroll along the pier.

Next, head to the fish market, where you can witness the lively trade of freshly caught seafood and get a glimpse of the traditional fishing culture. From there, visit the El Mina Mosque, one of the most significant religious landmarks in Hurghada. Admire its intricate Islamic architecture and learn about its cultural significance.

Continue your journey to the Coptic Church, an important site reflecting Egypt’s Christian heritage. Your guide will provide insights into the history and traditions of the local Coptic community.

Afterward, delve into Hurghada’s traditional souks and bazaars, where you can browse for local spices, handmade crafts, and souvenirs. Feel free to test your bargaining skills and take home a unique keepsake.

To complete your tour, indulge in a delightful seafood lunch at a highly rated local restaurant. Enjoy a selection of freshly prepared seafood dishes cooked with traditional flavors and served in an authentic setting.

After an unforgettable experience, your driver will take you back to your hotel, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing end to your day.

Visit the picturesque Hurghada Marina and enjoy stunning sea views.
Explore the lively fish market and see how locals trade their daily catch.
Enjoy a fresh and flavorful seafood lunch at a top-rated local restaurant.

Start your tour with a visit to the Hurghada Marina, a modern waterfront promenade lined with luxury yachts, restaurants, and cafés. Capture the beauty of the Red Sea and enjoy a relaxing stroll along the pier.

Next, head to the fish market, where you can witness the lively trade of freshly caught seafood and get a glimpse of the traditional fishing culture. From there, visit the El Mina Mosque, one of the most significant religious landmarks in Hurghada. Admire its intricate Islamic architecture and learn about its cultural significance.

Continue your journey to the Coptic Church, an important site reflecting Egypt’s Christian heritage. Your guide will provide insights into the history and traditions of the local Coptic community.

Afterward, delve into Hurghada’s traditional souks and bazaars, where you can browse for local spices, handmade crafts, and souvenirs. Feel free to test your bargaining skills and take home a unique keepsake.

To complete your tour, indulge in a delightful seafood lunch at a highly rated local restaurant. Enjoy a selection of freshly prepared seafood dishes cooked with traditional flavors and served in an authentic setting.

After an unforgettable experience, your driver will take you back to your hotel, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing end to your day.

short_description: Spark your adrenaline on a quad ride through the desert. Depart from Hurghada and experience a thrilling ride through the dunes to a Bedouin village, try traditional tea, and ride a camel.
full_description:
Admire the rolling dunes on a fast-paced quad bike tour from Hurghada or nearby cities.
Afterward, relish a more traditional desert experience with a camel ride and a visit to a Bedouin village. Sip a traditional herbal tea and learn about local life.

Be picked up from your hotel and taken to our private quad bike station, where you will have the chance to test drive and learn all the important details of the vehicle before setting off on the tour.

Get into gear and conquer the dunes. Let the desert flash past you and feel the adrenaline rush through your body. After about an hour, you will reach a Bedouin village.

Relaxation, black tea, and the Bedouin lifestyle can be experienced here, as well as a camel ride before returning to the starting point in the dunes.

full_description:
Join us for an unforgettable dolphin-watching adventure on the crystal-clear waters of the Red Sea. Departing from Hurghada, this full-day boat tour combines relaxation, exploration, and excitement.

Cruise to known dolphin hotspots where you’ll have the chance to see these incredible creatures in the wild. Then dive into the water at two beautiful snorkelling locations, where you'll explore vibrant coral reefs teeming with marine life.

Between stops, relax on the sundeck, enjoy music, and take in the stunning views. A fresh buffet lunch will be served on board, along with soft drinks to keep you refreshed throughout the day.

This tour is ideal for nature lovers, families, and anyone looking to experience the magic of the Red Sea.

title: Supply Partner |
short_description: Leave Hurghada and head to explore the beautiful underwater world surrounding Sharm El Naga National Park on this private snorkeling adventure. Enjoy a buffet lunch onboard with stunning views.
full_description:
Your day begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel in Hurghada. Your friendly guide will greet you and transport you to Sharm El Naga in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. Sit back and enjoy the scenic drive along the picturesque coastline of the Red Sea as you make your way to Sharm El Naga. Enjoy breathtaking views of the desert landscape and sparkling waters along the way.

Upon arrival at Sharm El Naga, you'll be mesmerized by the beauty of this pristine coastal area. With its crystal-clear waters and vibrant coral reefs, Sharm El Naga is a haven for snorkeling enthusiasts and nature lovers. Gear up with your snorkeling equipment and prepare to explore Sharm El Naga's incredible underwater world. Dive into the warm, turquoise waters and marvel at the colorful coral gardens teeming with exotic marine life. Swim alongside tropical fish and vibrant corals, and maybe even encounter sea turtles and dolphins.

After your snorkeling adventure, take some time to relax and unwind on the sandy shores of Sharm El Naga. Bask in the Egyptian sunshine, swim in the refreshing sea, or simply lounge on the beach and soak up the tranquil atmosphere. Refuel with a delicious lunch served at a beachside restaurant, where you can savor traditional Egyptian cuisine and refreshing beverages.
