Full description
Your day begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel in Hurghada. Your friendly guide will greet you and transport you to Sharm El Naga in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. Sit back and enjoy the scenic drive along the picturesque coastline of the Red Sea as you make your way to Sharm El Naga. Enjoy breathtaking views of the desert landscape and sparkling waters along the way.

Upon arrival at Sharm El Naga, you'll be mesmerized by the beauty of this pristine coastal area. With its crystal-clear waters and vibrant coral reefs, Sharm El Naga is a haven for snorkeling enthusiasts and nature lovers. Gear up with your snorkeling equipment and prepare to explore Sharm El Naga's incredible underwater world. Dive into the warm, turquoise waters and marvel at the colorful coral gardens teeming with exotic marine life. Swim alongside tropical fish and vibrant corals, and maybe even encounter sea turtles and dolphins.

After your snorkeling adventure, take some time to relax and unwind on the sandy shores of Sharm El Naga. Bask in the Egyptian sunshine, swim in the refreshing sea, or simply lounge on the beach and soak up the tranquil atmosphere. Refuel with a delicious lunch served at a beachside restaurant, where you can savor traditional Egyptian cuisine and refreshing beverages.

After a day of sun, sea, and snorkeling, it's time to bid farewell to Sharm El Naga and head back to Hurghada. Board your vehicle and relax during the return journey to your hotel, where you'll arrive in the late afternoon.

short_description: Fly from Hurghada for a full-day Cairo tour. Visit the Pyramids, the Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum. Discover Egypt's history, explore modern culture, and shop for organic oils and scarves with FTS.
full_description:
Embark on a seamless and exciting full-day trip from Hurghada to Cairo by plane. Begin your adventure with a morning flight that takes you directly to Egypt’s vibrant capital, Cairo. Upon arrival, your professional guide will meet you at the airport and escort you to the legendary Giza Pyramids. Here, you'll stand in awe at the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, and the Pyramid of Menkaure. You’ll also have time to visit the iconic Sphinx, where you can take memorable photos.

Afterward, head to the world-renowned Egyptian Museum. Inside, explore thousands of ancient artifacts, including the treasures of King Tutankhamun and stunning relics from ancient Egyptian civilization. Your guide will offer fascinating insights into Egypt’s rich history and the significance of the pieces on display.

Next, enjoy a traditional Egyptian lunch at a local restaurant, where you can savor authentic Egyptian flavors and dishes. Post-lunch, you’ll have some free time to visit Khan El Khalili, Cairo's famous bazaar, where you can shop for souvenirs, spices, jewelry, and handcrafted goods, or simply enjoy the lively atmosphere of the market.

After a day full of exploration, you will be transferred back to Cairo Airport for your flight back to Hurghada, where your unforgettable experience in Egypt concludes. Whether you're a history enthusiast or a traveler seeking cultural immersion, this full-day trip to Cairo promises to be an enriching and unforgettable journey.

short_description: Travel from Hurghada to Cairo for a full-day guided tour of the Pyramids, Sphinx, and Egyptian Museum. Discover ancient wonders and explore Egypt’s rich history in one unforgettable day.
full_description:
Discover the wonders of ancient Egypt on a full-day guided tour from Hurghada to Cairo. Travel in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle and explore one of the most historically rich cities in the world.

Begin your journey at the Giza Plateau, where you’ll witness the awe-inspiring Great Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Valley Temple. Your expert guide will share fascinating insights into the history, architecture, and legends of these iconic monuments.

Next, visit the world-renowned Egyptian Museum, home to an extraordinary collection of pharaonic antiquities, including royal mummies and treasures from the tomb of King Tutankhamun. You’ll have time to browse the exhibits and immerse yourself in over 5,000 years of history.

Enjoy free time for lunch and, if available, take a relaxing Nile boat ride (optional) for a different view of Cairo's vibrant cityscape.

This day trip offers a perfect blend of cultural discovery and sightseeing. After an enriching experience, you'll head back to Hurghada with unforgettable memories of Egypt’s ancient past.

short_description: Discover the Red Sea’s underwater beauty on a glass-bottom boat trip from Hurghada with snorkeling. Then, soar 40 meters high and enjoy stunning views on an unforgettable parasailing adventure.
full_description:
Embark on a semi-submarine adventure and explore the stunning underwater world off Hurghada’s shores. Gaze through large panoramic windows to admire vibrant coral reefs and marine life.

Start your journey with a comfortable hotel pickup in an air-conditioned vehicle. Snorkel into the crystal-clear waters of the Red Sea and enjoy 40 minutes of snorkeling, discovering colorful fish and breathtaking corals.

For an extra thrill, experience parasailing, where one or two people soar 30–40 meters above the sea, enjoying 4–7 minutes of flight time with no prior training required.

Capture unforgettable moments with stunning photos before concluding your adventure with a smooth hotel drop-off.

short_description: Set off on an action-packed tour from Hurghada. Zoom through the desert on a jeep, take sunset photos, visit a Bedouin village, ride a camel, drink Bedouin tea, and have a barbecue dinner with a show.
full_description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure with our Jeep & Camel Safari in the breathtaking desert landscapes of Hurghada. Your journey begins with a thrilling 4x4 jeep ride through the sandy dunes, where you’ll experience the exhilaration of off-road driving and take in the panoramic views of the Egyptian desert.

Next, you’ll swap the wheels for camels as you ride these gentle giants through the vast desert terrain, immersing yourself in the serene beauty of the Egyptian wilderness. The camel ride offers a perfect photo opportunity, allowing you to capture the essence of the desert.

After your camel ride, you’ll arrive at a traditional Bedouin village, where you’ll have the chance to explore the local culture and interact with the friendly inhabitants. Enjoy a delicious BBQ dinner under the stars, featuring a selection of fresh and flavorful Egyptian dishes.

As the night unfolds, you’ll be treated to a spectacular fire show, where skilled performers will light up the night sky with dazzling fire tricks. Feel the heat and excitement of this thrilling display, all while enjoying the warm ambiance of the desert night.

This adventure combines the perfect mix of cultural discovery, outdoor excitement, and traditional entertainment, leaving you with memories to cherish for years to come.

short_description: If you're planning on visiting Jerusalem, you will cover with a tour that takes you to the Mount of Olives, the Western Wall, and much more. you won't want to miss out on these amazing experiences.
full_description:
Embark on your Jerusalem journey from Hurghada as our guide picks you up from your hotel and takes you to Hurghada airport, from where you will fly to Taba. After arriving in Taba, you will take a bus to the Egyptian-Israeli border.

On the way from Taba to Jerusalem, you will have time for breakfast. Upon arrival in Jerusalem, your journey will begin from El Gouna with the famous Mount of Olives, offering you a chance to enjoy an overwhelming view of the old city. Visit the Western Wall, located within the old city and a remnant of the ancient wall surrounding the Jewish Temples. Discover the Church of the Holy Sepulchre and explore the Tomb of King David, discovered during the church's restoration. Then, explore the birthplace of Jesus in Bethlehem, and have lunch during the tour before heading to the beautiful Dead Sea, where you can swim, relax and enjoy the salty water.

At the end of the day, you will be taken back to Taba to cross the border and then fly to Hurghada. We will welcome you in Hurghada and take you to your hotel with a modern, air-conditioned vehicle.

short_description: Discover the capital of the Pharaohs and its architectural legacy on a full-day tour from Safaga or Makadi. See the Valley of the Kings, Karnak Temple, and Hatshepsut Temple at Deir el-Bahari.
full_description:
Your journey begins early in the morning with pickup from your hotel in Hurghada. Travel in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle through the Egyptian desert, enjoying scenic views of the Nile Valley along the way.

Stop 1: Karnak Temple
Upon arrival in Luxor, your first stop is Karnak Temple, a vast complex with towering columns, massive statues, and sacred lakes. Walk through the Great Hypostyle Hall, an architectural masterpiece with 134 giant columns, and learn about the Temple of Amun-Ra, the heart of ancient Thebes.

Stop 2: Lunch at a Local Restaurant
After exploring Karnak, enjoy a relaxing lunch at a restaurant along the Nile River, where you can taste authentic Egyptian cuisine.

Stop 3: Valley of the Kings
Next, head to the Valley of the Kings, the famous burial ground of pharaohs, including Tutankhamun and Ramses II. Visit three magnificent tombs, each decorated with well-preserved hieroglyphs and paintings that depict the journey to the afterlife.

Stop 4: Temple of Hatshepsut
Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, a breathtaking three-tiered structure carved into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari. Learn about the powerful female pharaoh who ruled Egypt as a king.

Stop 5: Colossi of Memnon
Before heading back, make a quick stop at the Colossi of Memnon, two gigantic statues that once guarded the entrance to a great temple.

Optional: Felucca Ride on the Nile
If you’d like, you can enjoy a traditional felucca ride on the Nile (available for an extra fee), offering a peaceful experience on the legendary river.

Finally, relax as you travel back to Hurghada, where you’ll be dropped off at your hotel in the evening.

Marvel at the stunning Temple of Queen Hatshepsut

Enjoy a guided tour with an Egyptologist to uncover fascinating history

Explore the wonders of ancient Egypt on this captivating full-day guided tour from Hurghada. Your day begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle, ensuring a pleasant journey to Luxor city.

Start your adventure at the magnificent Karnak Temple, strolling along its spectacular Avenue of Sphinxes. Marvel at the imposing columns, intricate hieroglyphs, and awe-inspiring architecture as your guide shares fascinating insights into Egypt’s rich history.

Explore the renowned Valley of the Kings, where Egypt’s greatest pharaohs were laid to rest, including a chance to view the vibrant tomb paintings and hieroglyphs.

Visit the stunning Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, dedicated to Egypt’s iconic female Pharaoh, notable for its unique terraces and vividly preserved artwork. Afterwards, stop by the Colossi of Memnon—two towering statues guarding the ancient entrance to Amenhotep III’s temple complex.

Enjoy a delicious buffet lunch at a local Luxor restaurant, refueling before continuing your exploration. Throughout the day, you'll be provided with breakfast snacks, cold drinks, and water to keep refreshed and energized.

End your memorable journey with a comfortable ride back to your hotel, enriched by an unforgettable glimpse into Egypt’s majestic past

Start your day with a pickup from your hotel in Hurghada. Relax on the ride to Neverland Aqua Park, located just 25 minutes from downtown Hurghada. Upon arrival, check in and receive your wristbands for access to all the park's facilities.

Experience the thrill of 35 different water slides, each offering unique twists, turns, and drops. Dive into 14 outdoor swimming pools, perfect for both relaxation and adventure. There's even a heated pool for those who prefer warmer waters.

Enjoy the park's wave pools, designed to give you the sensation of being at the beach. Grab a raft and go for a ride down the lazy river or tackle more adventurous rapids. Explore serene water lakes, ideal for a leisurely paddle or simply soaking up the sun.

Relax poolside with sun beds and umbrellas available to provide shade and comfort. Satisfy your hunger and quench your thirst at the various food outlets and snack bars located throughout the park.

Get transferred back to your hotel in Hurghada at the end of the day.

Take in a show while you're in Hurghada with entry tickets to Neverland at the Alf Leila Wa Leila Hotel. Enjoy a dazzling display of music, dance, lights, and theater.




Get picked up from your hotel and make your way to the Alf Leila Wa Leila Hotel. Find your seats and relax as you wait for the show to start. 




Starting at 7:30, sit back two and half hours of international pop music, skilled dancers, and brilliant lights. Watch over 50 dancers from a variety of countries.




See some Egyptian style belly dancing and listen to the sound of Egyptian music. Savor a traditional Moroccan dinner before getting transferred back to your hotel.

short_description: Escape to paradise on a luxury cruise from Hurghada to Orange Bay. With snorkeling, water sports, and lunch, it's a perfect day of fun, sun, and relaxation on the Red Sea.
full_description:
Embark on a full-day luxury cruise from Hurghada to the stunning Orange Bay Island, where crystal-clear turquoise waters and soft white sands await. Your adventure begins with a comfortable hotel pickup and transfer to the marina, where you'll board a spacious, modern yacht equipped with sun loungers, shaded seating, restrooms, and snorkeling gear.

Sail across the Red Sea and stop at two of the area's best snorkeling spots. Dive into vibrant coral reefs teeming with colorful fish and marine life, guided by professional instructors who ensure your safety and enjoyment. After snorkeling, continue your journey to Orange Bay, one of the most picturesque islands near Hurghada. Relax on the beach, enjoy the clear shallow waters, or take photos on the famous wooden swings and hammocks in the sea.

Back on board, enjoy a freshly prepared buffet lunch with a selection of local dishes, soft drinks, and seasonal fruits. After lunch, enjoy fun water sports activities like banana boat or sofa rides (weather permitting) before slowly cruising back to the marina. At the end of the trip, you’ll be transferred back to your hotel, filled with unforgettable memories of a perfect day at sea.

This trip combines relaxation, adventure, and natural beauty, making it ideal for couples, families, and solo travelers alike.
highlights: Enjoy with a luxury cruise on a modern yacht with sun decks, shaded areas.
Snorkel at two vibrant coral reef spots filled with colorful marine life.
Relax on the stunning Orange Bay clear waters, soft white sands, beach swings.
Capture unforgettable photos in one of the most spots on the Red Sea coast.
Experience fun water activities like banana boat or sofa for an extra thrill.

Return to the boat and travel to the initial diving and snorkelling location, where you will be guaranteed an exceptional experience, complete with vibrant fish. Get a glimpse of the fascinating coral reefs and the ecosystem they sustain.

Go back to the boat and savour a mouthwatering buffet lunch while taking in the stunning views of the Red Sea. When you're feeling energised and refuelled, go to your second reef stop for more snorkelling and swimming.

Lastly, engage in some aquatic entertainment by participating in water sports, such as banana boat and speedboat or sofa, before heading back to Hurghada at the end of the afternoon.

A delicious lunch will be served on the island or boat, accompanied by soft drinks. This trip offers the perfect balance of relaxation and excitement, making it ideal for families, couples, and groups.

After a day in paradise, cruise back to Hurghada with great memories and breathtaking views.

Enjoy a seamless and stress-free start or end to your stay in Hurghada with our private one-way airport transfer service. Upon arrival, your personal driver will greet you at the airport holding a sign with your name, assist with your luggage, and escort you to your private, air-conditioned vehicle. Sit back and relax during a comfortable ride to your hotel, resort, or chosen address in Hurghada, with no stops along the way.

If departing, your driver will pick you up directly from your accommodation at a pre-confirmed time, assist with your bags, and ensure timely arrival at the airport for your flight. Whether arriving or leaving, this reliable and personalized service is the perfect way to avoid the hassle of taxis or crowded shuttle buses. Our professional drivers prioritize your comfort, safety, and punctuality, making your journey smooth and pleasant from door to door.

Enjoy a delicious BBQ dinner and indulge in Bedouin Tea. Travel through the desert on a camel and capture breathtaking images of the sunset between mountains and red sea hills in the vast desert.

You will be picked up from your hotel and driven to the Sahara.

Have fun while you're away from the hustle and bustle of the big city and marvel at the wonders of the desert.

Enjoy an exhilarating ride on an ATV Quad across the desert, then take a buggy ride on the dunes—snack on a tasty barbecue dinner and grilled delicacies. Observe oriental music and witness Tanoura dance and fire performances at the Bedouin tent.

short_description: Enjoy sunset views from the mountain with an open-buffet Bedouin dinner. you’ll be entertained by the Sahara Park Evening Show, which includes a Tanura, belly dancing and Fakir show performance.
full_description:
The tour may begin with a meeting point where participants gather or with a pickup from your hotel. Confirm the meeting time and location with your tour operator.
Upon arrival at the starting point, you'll receive a safety briefing and an orientation on how to operate the quad bike. Quad bikes are designed for desert terrain and are easy to handle.
Embark on an exhilarating quad bike adventure as you ride through the desert, navigating dunes and open desert trails.
As the day turns to night, you'll have the opportunity for stargazing with a telescope. Knowledgeable guides may point out constellations, stars, planets, and celestial objects while providing insights into the night sky.
After sunset, you'll head to a Bedouin-style desert camp where you can savor an open-buffet Bedouin dinner. Bedouin cuisine often includes dishes like grilled meats, salads, bread, and traditional Middle Eastern dishes. You'll have the chance to enjoy a hearty meal under the starry desert sky.
Following dinner, the entertainment begins with the Sahara Park Evening Show. This show typically includes various performances, Tanura Dance, and Belly Dancing.
Conclude the quad bike tour and stargazing experience by returning to the starting point or the designated endpoint. You'll be transported back to your hotel after the tour.

short_description: The Hurghada Sea and Mountains Quad Tour or Buggy tour combines adrenaline-pumping quad biking with the natural beauty of the region, making it suitable for both adults and children to enjoy together.
full_description:
Your adventure begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel, followed by a scenic drive towards the Red Sea Mountains. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted by a multilingual professional guide who will provide you with a thorough safety briefing and an overview of the day's itinerary.
Once you're briefed and ready to roll, it's time to hop on your quad bike towards Makadi Bay, you'll have the chance to ride along the desert, taking in the picturesque views of the Red Sea. Each one will get the Quad. If you can't ride the Quad, don't worry, you could join the guide or your family in the same quad.
if you choose the option to ride also buggy tour, Your next stop on the adventure is a visit to a desert falcon house, where you'll have the opportunity to transfer to a buggy for the next leg of the journey. Strap in and get ready for an exhilarating buggy ride across the sandy terrain, surrounded by imposing mountains and stunning desert vistas. If you are a good rider, you can choose each one and get one Buggy or 2 people in the same buggy together.
To cap off your adventure, you'll embark on a relaxing camel ride across the sand, immersing yourself in the tranquil beauty of the desert landscape. Take in the sights and sounds of the desert as you leisurely traverse the sandy dunes, creating memories that will last a lifetime.
After a day filled with excitement and adventure, you'll be dropped back at your hotel, where you can reflect on your incredible journey through the Red Sea Mountains and Makadi Bay. It's an experience you'll never forget!

short_description: Go on a safari tour through the Red Sea desert on this stargazing adventure. Watch the sunset in the desert, savor a BBQ dinner, and travel to an observatory to view the sky and learn about the stars.
full_description:
You’ll usually be picked up around 04.00 PM (Depending on your Hotel’s location In Hurghada) to go see the Starwatching with a Jeep Tour.
Embark on an exhilarating Jeep ride into the desert, enjoying the rugged landscape and interesting adventure by crossing into the Hurghada Desert Mountains and hills for 26 km to reach our fabulous place where the camels are waiting for you.
You will then be for 20 minutes with the opportunity to have unforgettable photos with camels. Then move for the Bedouin tent for your hospitality taste Herbal Bedouin tea.
You will see how they do handmade Carpets, bracelets, and necklaces. Watching the sunset in the desert can be a breathtaking part of the experience, setting the stage for the night's starwatching.
The romantic time will start with candlelight style in the dark desert while the Bedouin man is barbecuing delicious food.
The professional Astronomer will move with you to the Telescope Area where we have our MAEDA brand telescope (One of the Powerful Telescopes in the World with a very high magnification). All the photos are taken from the Telescope
our guide will take you on a dreamy journey to the edge of the universe to enjoy the vision of the distant universe from the earth, then you will see some planets in our galaxy.
With the Quad Option, you will be picked up by Jeep and Enjoy around 30 minutes of Quad.
After finish, you will be transferred back to your hotel.
highlights: Experience an exhilarating Jeep safari through the Hurghada desert.
Stargaze through a professional telescope and learn about stars and planets.
Enjoy a romantic BBQ dinner in a Bedouin camp under the starlit sky.
Watch a mesmerizing sunset over the Red Sea mountains.
Immerse yourself in Bedouin culture with herbal tea and camel rides.
inclusions: Soft drink during the sunset and dinner

short_description: Experience a camel ride, stargazing, and a traditional dinner in the Sahl Hasheesh desert. A magical night under the stars, with expert guides and a local Bedouin meal.
full_description:
Leave the city behind and embark on a magical desert adventure in Sahl Hasheesh. Begin your journey with a thrilling ride through the golden dunes, where you’ll witness the stunning desert landscape during sunset. Upon arrival at the Bedouin-style camp, you’ll be welcomed with traditional hospitality and enjoy a freshly prepared BBQ dinner under the open sky.

As night falls, immerse yourself in the silence and beauty of the desert. With the help of expert guides and high-powered telescopes, explore the wonders of the night sky, spot constellations, planets, and even distant galaxies. This unique experience combines adventure, culture, and nature, offering a peaceful escape and unforgettable memories.

Whether you're a couple, family, or solo traveller, this stargazing tour is the perfect way to enjoy the beauty of Egypt's desert night.

title: Supply Partner |
short_description: Experience the thrill of a 4WD Jeep Safari deep in the Egyptian desert near the Red Sea. Here's what you can look forward to on this extraordinary adventure.
full_description:
Your adventure kicks off with an exhilarating 4WD Jeep Safari into the heart of the Egyptian desert. As you traverse the stunning landscapes, you'll soak in the serene beauty and vastness of the area.

A key highlight of the tour is meeting the local Bedouin people, where you'll get an authentic glimpse of their traditional lifestyle, culture, and warm hospitality. You may engage in activities like learning about their handicrafts, preparing traditional meals together, or enjoying games with the community.

You'll also have the opportunity to try on traditional Bedouin attire and capture unforgettable moments with photographs, fully immersing yourself in the rich local traditions.

full_description:
Avoid waiting in line or queue by pre-booking your tickets to the sound and light show. Make sure to obtain the QR tickets from your supplier one day before your visit. Please be aware that the QR GetYourGuide confirmation only serves as a booking confirmation and cannot be used as an entrance ticket. Your supplier will send you another QR ticket, authorized by the Ministry of Tourism, one day before your visit. If you happen to book on the same day, our supplier will contact you directly to send the tickets as soon as possible. On the day of your visit, it may be necessary to go through a security check before entering. Present your QR code to the staff, who will then scan it to grant you access. If someone informs you that your ticket is not valid, contact your supplier immediately and do not make any additional payments. Secure your ticket today to uncover the mysteries surrounding the historic title of the temple known as Thebes, and delve into the exploration of its prominent landmarks.
Don't miss the chance to witness the different accomplishments of the Pharaohs. As you enter Luxor, you will be amazed by the city's impressive monuments and temples that have secured its place in history. Despite the damage to many monuments, this temple stands out as one of Egypt's greatest accomplishments, showcasing the creativity and unparalleled architecture of the ancient Egyptians.
At the Light and Sound show at Karnak temple, you will learn more about the impressive accomplishments of the past.
Select one of the 10 available languages from the show and enjoy listening to the captivating story

Note: if you need to make a transfer from your hotel it will be with extra fees please lets us know

Accompanied by a licensed Egyptologist, you'll explore the vast halls and towering columns of Karnak, the largest temple complex in ancient Egypt. Then continue to Luxor Temple, beautifully aligned with the Nile and rich in historical symbolism from the New Kingdom.

Enjoy a relaxing break with lunch at a local restaurant, then top off your day with a free traditional horse carriage ride through the vibrant streets of Luxor.

Entry fees to the temples are only included if the option is selected during booking, giving you flexibility based on your budget and interests.

short_description: Discover Luxor on a full-day customized private tour with expert guide, local lunch, and a horse carriage ride. Design your own adventure through Egypt’s ancient wonders!
full_description:
Embark on a full-day customized private tour through the timeless treasures of Luxor. Whether you're passionate about pharaohs, temples, or royal tombs, this flexible tour allows you to design your perfect day with the help of a professional Egyptologist guide.

Start your experience with pickup from your hotel or Luxor Airport, then travel in a private air-conditioned vehicle to explore the landmarks you choose—like Karnak Temple, the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, or Luxor Temple.

To add a special cultural touch, enjoy a free traditional horse carriage ride through the scenic streets of the city. You'll also stop for a local lunch at a handpicked restaurant and receive bottled water throughout the tour.

Entrance fees to the sites are not included by default, but you can easily select your preferred monuments as add-ons when booking.

Whether you're a first-time visitor or a returning explorer, this fully customized private tour offers insight, flexibility, and comfort—all in one unforgettable day in Luxor.

short_description: Enjoy a magical sound and light show at the Giza Pyramids with a delicious dinner and stunning night views. A unique blend of history, lights, and flavors awaits you!
full_description:
Enjoy an unforgettable evening at the foot of the majestic Giza Pyramids with this immersive sound and light show experience, paired with a delicious dinner. Your evening begins with convenient hotel pickup and a comfortable transfer to a premium rooftop or garden restaurant with direct views of the illuminated pyramids. As the sun sets and the sky darkens, savor a carefully prepared dinner featuring traditional Egyptian cuisine in a unique and atmospheric setting.

After dinner, watch the pyramids come alive during the world-renowned sound and light show. Through captivating narration and dazzling light projections, the show tells the story of ancient Egypt, its legendary pharaohs, and the wonders of the Giza Plateau. The Sphinx acts as the narrator, guiding you through thousands of years of history in an unforgettable performance.

This experience is ideal for couples, families, and anyone wanting to enjoy Cairo’s ancient landmarks in a magical and relaxed setting. After the show, your driver will transfer you comfortably back to your hotel.
highlights: Learn the Egyptian history from the sound and light show
Enjoy your dinner with a unique view of the great pyramids
See the pyramids and Sphinx illuminated against the desert sands

Your evening begins with convenient hotel pickup and a comfortable transfer to a premium rooftop or garden restaurant with direct views of the illuminated pyramids. As the sun sets and the sky darkens, savor a carefully prepared dinner featuring traditional Egyptian cuisine in a unique and atmospheric setting.

After dinner, watch the pyramids come alive during the world-renowned sound and light show. Through captivating narration and dazzling light projections, the show tells the story of ancient Egypt, its legendary pharaohs, and the wonders of the Giza Plateau. The Sphinx acts as the narrator, guiding you through thousands of years of history in an unforgettable performance.

This experience is ideal for couples, families, and anyone wanting to enjoy Cairo’s ancient landmarks in a magical and relaxed setting. After the show, your driver will transfer you comfortably back to your hotel.

short_description: Experience an unforgettable evening in the desert with a thrilling jeep safari, traditional Bedouin dinner, and magical stargazing under the clear desert sky.
full_description:
Embark on an unforgettable desert adventure combining adrenaline, culture, and celestial beauty. This all-in-one experience takes you deep into the Eastern Desert for a perfect blend of thrill, tradition, and relaxation under the stars.

4x4 Desert Jeep Ride
Kick off your journey with an exhilarating ride through golden dunes in a rugged 4x4 jeep, an exciting start to your desert expedition.

Quad Bike (ATV) Experience
Feel the rush as you ride your own quad bike across the open desert plains. An ideal activity for adventure lovers!

Buggy Ride
Hop into a desert buggy for a fun and bumpy ride over the dunes — perfect for those seeking an extra dose of excitement.

Camel Ride
Slow down and take in the scenery from the back of a camel, just like the Bedouins have done for centuries.

Arrival at the Bedouin Camp
Step into traditional Bedouin life with a visit to a welcoming desert camp. Experience warm Arabian hospitality in an authentic setting.

Refreshments on Arrival
Enjoy a calming cup of Bedouin tea and chilled mineral water as you settle in and prepare for the evening’s activities.

Sunset Viewing
Pause your adventure to witness the magical colors of the desert sunset, a moment made for photos and peaceful reflection.

Traditional Bedouin Dinner
Savor a hearty Bedouin-style BBQ dinner featuring grilled meats, local dishes, and traditional flavors, served under the stars.

Evening Entertainment
Enjoy live cultural performances with traditional music and dancing (subject to availability) for a festive desert evening.

Telescope Stargazing Session
Wrap up your night with a guided stargazing session. Use a telescope to explore the night sky and learn about planets, constellations, and cosmic wonders from an expert guide.

title: Supply Partner |
short_description: Discover the untouched nature of Hamata National Park on a snorkeling adventure. Admire the beautiful corals and colorful fish around the islands and enjoy lunch at sea.
full_description:
Embark on a full day of snorkeling in the pristine natural beauty around the Hamata Islands. On this guided trip, sail around the three Virgin Islands, explore the lagoons and reefs, and enjoy lunch while on board. See tropical fish, corals, and birds as you visit the islands.

To begin your tour, enjoy a pickup service from your hotel in Marsa Alam to the Hamata Marina. There, meet your snorkeling guide, board your boat, and chart a course for the Hamata Islands. Sail across the crystal-clear tropical water of the Red Sea with the warm breeze fresh on your cheeks.

Continue your tour as you cruise around the islands of Hamata National Park. Dive into the brilliant blue waters for an up-close experience of coral reefs while cheerful rainbows of colorful tropical fish dart past. Paddle around lagoons and roam the habitat of dolphins, turtles, and rays.

Next, your captain will dock the boat for a land excursion at one of the islands. Treat yourself to a walk along the pure white sandy beach and spot an array of tropical birds fluttering around their idyllic island home.

After you've strolled the sandy beaches, board your boat once again for an open buffet lunch at sea. Regain your energy and relax on the gentle waves. After lunch, your captain will guide you to the final snorkeling site, where you can explore the natural beauty of the underwater world once more.

Finally, cruise back to the Hamata Marina. From there, conclude your tour with a return transport service to your hotel in Marsa Alam.

Snorkel and explore the serene natural beauty of coral reefs and lagoons

Relax and enjoy a buffet lunch and refreshments on board your boat

short_description: Discover the magic of Marsa Alam on this unforgettable adventure. Ride through stunning desert and coastal landscapes on horseback, followed by a serene stargazing experience under crystal-clear skies
full_description:
Your exciting desert safari begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel in a comfortable, air-conditioned van.
Upon arrival at the safari station, you’ll be warmly welcomed by your guides and companions for the journey. A brief introduction will cover trip instructions and safety guidelines. Your guides will assist you in wrapping your scarf properly and provide a quick tutorial on driving an ATV.
Savor a refreshing cup of traditional Bedouin tea in an authentic setting.

Board an air-conditioned car for a journey to a Bedouin camp, where the adventure continues. Watch and taste the process of making Bedouin bread, Ride a camel and enjoy a panoramic view of the stunning mountains. Visit Bedouin stores showcasing herbs and unique handicrafts.

As night falls, the lights are turned off to reveal a breathtaking starry sky. With the help of astronomical telescopes, you’ll have the chance to observe stars and planets up close.
The adventure concludes with a comfortable ride back to your hotel in an air-conditioned car, leaving you with unforgettable memories of the desert.
highlights: Sunset Horseback Ride along the coastline and through desert dunes.
Stargazing Session under Egypt’s clearest skies with expert guidance.
Bedouin Hospitality with traditional tea in a peaceful desert setting.
Capture moments as the sun dips below the horizon and stars begin to sparkle.

short_description: Swim alongside playful dolphins and explore the vibrant coral reefs of Shaab Samadai in Marsa Alam, an unforgettable marine adventure in crystal-clear waters.
full_description:
Embark on a full-day marine adventure to one of Egypt’s most enchanting snorkeling and diving spots. Shaab Samadai is home to a large population of spinner dolphins, offering you the rare chance to see these playful creatures in their natural habitat.

Your day begins with a scenic boat trip from Marsa Alam to the reef, where turquoise waters and colorful coral gardens await. Upon arrival, you’ll have the opportunity to snorkel or dive in carefully selected spots, guided by experienced instructors. Witness vibrant marine life, from exotic fish to stunning coral formations, while respecting the protected environment.

Between sessions, relax on the boat, enjoy refreshments, and soak up the sun. The trip is suitable for all levels, from beginners to seasoned ocean lovers, and combines adventure with the serenity of the Red Sea.

short_description: Discover ancient Egyptian civilization on a day trip to Luxor from Marsa Alam. Visit the Temple of Karnak, Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut, and Valley of the Kings. Shop for oils and scarves at FTS.
full_description:
Start your adventure with an early morning pickup from your hotel in Marsa Alam. Relax in an air-conditioned vehicle as you drive through the Eastern Desert towards Luxor, one of Egypt’s most significant historical destinations.

West Bank – Valley of the Kings & More
Upon arrival in Luxor, cross the Nile to the West Bank, where the ancient pharaohs built their tombs to last for eternity. Your first stop is the Valley of the Kings, home to the tombs of legendary rulers like Tutankhamun, Seti I, and Ramses II. Explore three beautifully decorated tombs with intricate hieroglyphics and learn about the ancient burial rituals of the pharaohs.

Next, visit the Temple of Hatshepsut, an architectural masterpiece built into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari. Admire the grand colonnades and detailed carvings that honor one of Egypt’s most powerful female rulers.

Before leaving the West Bank, stop at the Colossi of Memnon, two massive statues of Pharaoh Amenhotep III that have stood for over 3,400 years. Hear fascinating stories about these legendary guardians of the Theban Necropolis.

East Bank – Karnak Temples
After a break for a delicious Egyptian-style lunch at a local restaurant, continue your journey to Luxor’s East Bank. Here, visit the Karnak Temples, the largest religious complex ever built. Walk through the majestic Great Hypostyle Hall, featuring 134 towering columns, and admire the sacred lake and the Avenue of Sphinxes. Your guide will reveal the hidden secrets of this magnificent site, which was expanded by multiple pharaohs over nearly 2,000 years.

Return to Marsa Alam
Following your exploration of Luxor, relax on the scenic drive back to Marsa Alam, arriving in the evening.

short_description: Join a full-day snorkeling trip from Marsa Alam to Sataya Reef (Dolphin House) and swim with wild dolphins in crystal-clear waters. Discover vibrant coral reefs and enjoy a magical Red Sea adventure.
full_description:
Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Red Sea on a full-day snorkeling trip to Sataya Reef, also known as Dolphin House, one of the most magical snorkeling spots near Marsa Alam. Known for its large population of wild dolphins, Sataya offers you a rare chance to swim and interact with these fascinating creatures in their natural habitat.

Your day begins with a convenient hotel pickup in Marsa Alam, followed by a transfer to the marina where your boat adventure starts. As you cruise through the crystal-clear waters, enjoy the stunning sea views and the peaceful atmosphere of the Red Sea.

Upon arrival at Sataya Reef, the adventure truly begins. This protected lagoon is famous for its frequent dolphin sightings, and you’ll have the unique opportunity to snorkel alongside spinner dolphins, who are known for their friendly and playful behavior. With the help of your experienced snorkeling guide, you’ll also explore the vibrant coral gardens, colorful fish, and other rich marine life that make this reef so special.

During the day, you'll stop at two or more snorkeling sites depending on the conditions, giving you plenty of time to explore and relax in the water. Back on board, enjoy a freshly prepared lunch, along with refreshing drinks throughout the journey.

The boat is equipped with comfortable shaded areas, sunbathing spots, and all the necessary snorkeling equipment including masks, snorkels, and life jackets. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced snorkeler, this trip is suitable for all levels and promises an unforgettable experience.

After a magical day at sea, the boat returns to the marina in the afternoon. You will then be transferred back to your hotel with memories that will last a lifetime.

short_description: Embark on a late-night journey from Dahab to Mt. Sinai. Climb the sacred mountain for a stunning sunrise, then explore St. Catherine's Monastery. Return to Dahab by early afternoon, blending history
full_description:
A comfortable air-conditioned vehicle will pick you up from your hotel in Dahab around 10:00 PM (exact time may vary depending on location). Drive through the desert landscapes to Saint Catherine, approximately a 2-hour journey.
Reach the starting point of the climb at Saint Catherine Village around midnight. Meet your Bedouin guide, who will assist you during the trek.
Begin the Ascent: Climb Mount Sinai, following a well-marked trail. The trek typically takes 2.5 to 3 hours. You can choose between Camel rides (available for an additional fee) or hiking on foot.
Reach the summit in time to witness the magnificent sunrise, a spiritual and breathtaking experience. Enjoy panoramic views of the rugged Sinai mountains as the sun lights up the desert landscape. Optional: Have a small snack or rest (bring water and light food).
Begin the trek back down the mountain, taking approximately 2 hours.
Arrive at the historic monastery, one of the oldest in Christianity. Believed to be the site where Moses spoke to God. Built around the holy site. Features ancient manuscripts and religious artifacts.
After the monastery visit, enjoy a simple breakfast in a nearby restaurant or village café.

title: Supply Partner |
short_description: this tour is fascinating journey into the history and of ancient Egypt. Below is a suggested itinerary for a day tour that covers the Mustafa Kamel Necropolis along with highlights of Alexandria.
full_description:
You'll be picked up from your hotel in Cairo early in the morning by a private, air-conditioned vehicle. The drive to Alexandria takes about 2.5 to 3 hours, depending on traffic. Enjoy the scenic drive through the Nile Delta region. Your guide may provide interesting commentary on the history and significance of the areas you pass.
Begin your tour at the Mustafa Kamel Necropolis, one of Alexandria’s lesser-known archaeological sites. This necropolis dates back to the 2nd century BC and consists of four tombs carved into the rock, each with distinct architectural and artistic elements.
Explore the Tombs: The tombs showcase remarkable Hellenistic art and design, including intricate carvings, vibrant frescoes, and inscriptions. Your guide will provide insight into the historical and cultural significance of the tombs and the people buried there. The site offers excellent opportunities for photography, with its beautiful carvings and serene surroundings.
Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, sampling Alexandria’s famous Mediterranean cuisine. Options include fresh seafood dishes, mezze, and traditional Egyptian fare.
Visit this iconic archaeological site, considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages. The catacombs blend Pharaonic, Greek, and Roman art and contain fascinating sculptures, carvings, and a central spiral staircase.
See this impressive Roman triumphal column, one of Alexandria's most famous landmarks. The pillar, made of red Aswan granite, stands 27 meters tall and was erected in honor of Emperor Diocletian.
End your tour with a visit to the Citadel of Qaitbay
After a full day of exploration, you'll head back to Cairo. You will be dropped off at your hotel in the evening, concluding your day tour.
highlights: Marvel in your First Stop - Mustafa Kamel Necropolis:
Admire the architectural excellence of the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa
Explore Pompey's Pillar, enjoying its artifacts and sculptures
Stroll along the ancient ramparts of the 15th century Citadel of Qaitbay
Dive into a Delightful Seafood Lunch
inclusions: Round-trip transportation from Cairo to Alexandria
Bottle of water during your tour

title: Supply Partner |
short_description: Explore the sites of Old Cairo, covering its Christian and Islamic heritage. You will enjoy a wonderful evening on a Nile River cruise, enjoying dinner and traditional entertainment.
full_description:
Your guide will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo or Giza to visit both Coptic and Islamic parts of old Cairo. First, you will go to the Sultan Hassan Mosque, which is one of the largest and most important medieval mosques in the world.

Next, you will explore Coptic Cairo, visiting the Babylon fortress and the St. Sergios Church dating back to the 4th century, where the holy family took refuge.

Saving the best for last, your tour will end with a 3-hour Nile cruise with dinner. An evening cruise on one of the Nile boats is a wonderful opportunity to spend and look at Cairo's skyline at night. During the evening, you will find both local and international cuisine options at an open buffet. In addition, you will watch a belly dance show, listen to Arabic songs and music, along with a Tanoura show while indulging in your delicious meal. Spend an evening in the open air, enjoy the good food, the unique entertainment and the magnificent views of the banks of the Nile.
highlights: Travel through Old Cairo which dates back to the 15th century
Visit the Sultan Hassan Mosque and then explore the churches in Coptic Cairo
Enjoy sailing on the River Nile aboard a traditional felucca wooden sailing boat
Watch traditional folkloric and belly dancing shows
inclusions: All transfers with a modern and air conditioned vehicle

full_description:
Your private guide and driver will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo in the early morning. The journey from Cairo to Alexandria takes approximately 2.5 to 3 hours. Enjoy the scenic drive as you make your way to this historic city along the Mediterranean coast.
You have in the program 2 options: you can choose the first option by visiting the below Sightseeing or you can customize your tour by adding the prefered Sightseeing.
Visit the Qaitbay Citadel, a 15th-century fortress built on the site of the legendary Lighthouse of Alexandria. Continue your tour at the Roman amphitheater of Kom El-Deka, a remarkable archaeological site. Next, visit the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, a fascinating burial site.
Lunch Break: Enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant.
Depending on your interests and available time, you can consider additional stops or activities. Options include a visit to Montaza Palace, a relaxing walk along Stanley Bridge, or exploring other historical and cultural sites in Alexandria.
Drive Back to Cairo: After a full day of exploration, your guide and driver will accompany you on the drive back to your hotel in Cairo.

short_description: Explore the Giza Pyramids and Sphinx on a private half-day tour with hotel pickup and tickets. Enjoy a free camel ride, photos, and insights from a certified Egyptologist.
full_description:
**Discover the magic of Ancient Egypt on a private half-day tour to the iconic Giza Plateau!**
Begin your adventure with a comfortable hotel pickup in Cairo or Giza and travel in a private, air-conditioned vehicle. Your expert Egyptologist guide will escort you through the timeless wonders of the Great Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinos—each with its own fascinating story and mystery.

Stand in awe before the mighty Sphinx, the legendary guardian with a lion’s body and a pharaoh’s face. Learn about the secrets of these ancient structures, their purpose, and the civilization that built them over 4,500 years ago.

What makes this tour even more special? **You’ll enjoy a free camel ride** through the golden sands surrounding the pyramids—an unforgettable way to experience the desert landscape and snap epic photos with these majestic monuments in the background.

Whether you're a history enthusiast, a photographer, or simply a curious traveler, this tour is designed to give you a perfect blend of knowledge, adventure, and memorable moments—all in just half a day.

Upgrade your experience with optional add-ons like professional photography

Climb around ancient stones and explore secrets with your guide.
Enter the Valley Temple where kings prepared for the afterlife.
Get up close to the Sphinx and snap bold, fun action shots.
Wrap up your journey and return with epic memories of Egypt.

short_description: Discover Cairo’s bustling markets and the iconic Khan El Khalili on a private shopping tour. With your expert guide, explore hidden gems, practice bartering, and take home unique souvenirs from Egypt
full_description:
You will be picked up from your hotel by a Sun Pyramids Tours representative to begin your private shopping adventure in Cairo’s historic downtown markets. Your journey starts at the vibrant El Ghorya Market, a classic Egyptian bazaar in the heart of charming Fatimid Cairo.

Stroll along the picturesque Gamalia Street, passing the historic gates of Bab Zuwayla, Bab al-Futuh, and Bab el-Nasr, before arriving at the famous Khan El Khalili Bazaars. Here, you’ll find an array of treasures, from brassware, copper, and leather goods to perfumes, silver, gold, antiques, and more.

After your shopping experience, you will be comfortably transferred back to your hotel.

full_description:
Begin your day by getting picked up from your hotel and taking a cruise to the diving site.

After arriving, start your tour with the yacht's team. The next step is to go to the best snorkeling and diving site.

Relaxing, unwinding, and enjoying the Red Sea weather in the middle of the open sea is something you can do during your stops.

Enjoy your boat ride with snorkeling sites and with 2 scuba diving stops.

Expert scuba diving instructors will guide and inform you about the dive sites before each dive. Relax with lunch served on board during the trip and unlimited drinks included during the whole day.

After diving, relaxing on board, lunch, and your diving stops, you will return to the port and be dropped off by car at your hotel.

short_description: Discover the popular destinations in Medina, Saudi Arabia, during this comprehensive & personalized full-day tour. Your guide will take care of all the arrangements, ensuring and enjoyable experience.
full_description: The tour leader or driver will be ready for you, Begin your journey by visiting Hegra, which is also called Madain Saleh or Al-Ḥijr. It is an archaeological site situated in the AlUla area in the Hejaz region of Saudi Arabia. Most of the ruins can be traced back to the Nabatean kingdom and this site is considered to be the southernmost and biggest settlement of the kingdom after Petra, the capital. Al-Hijr (Madain Saleh) is an archaeological site in Saudi Arabia that has been recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage property. Formerly known as Hegra, it is the largest preserved site of the Nabataean civilization, located south of Petra in Jordan. The site showcases well-preserved tombs with ornate designs that date back to the 1st century BC to the 1st century AD. Additionally, there are around 50 inscriptions from the pre-Nabataean era and some cave drawings. Al-Hijr is a remarkable testament to the civilization of the Nabataeans, featuring 111 large tombs, 94 of which are adorned, as well as water wells, showcasing their architectural and hydraulic expertise. Next, experience the beauty of Elephant Rock. This stunning natural formation, which bears a striking resemblance to an elephant with its trunk grazing the earth, has become one of AlUla's most celebrated landmarks due to its unique geological features.Elephant Rock, also called Jabal AlFil, is one of the numerous fascinating geological wonders found in AlUla. Afterwards, you can explore Jabal Ikmah, an outdoor library located throughout the Valley of AlUla. This site contains numerous ancient inscriptions in languages such as Aramaic, Dadanitic, Thamudic, Minaic, and Nabataean. Notably, it also showcases one of the earliest inscriptions from the Islamic era, dating all the way back to 24 AH (644 CE). AlUla is a significant place for studying the Arabic language due to the presence of thousands of pre-Arabic inscriptions scattered across many sites. One such site is AlAqra'a, a mountain located north of the AlUla Valley, which boasts over 450 early Arabic inscriptions. Another site, Naqsh Zuhayr, situated to the east, is known for housing one of the oldest Islamic era inscriptions, dating back to 24AH (644 CE). Located in a secluded canyon valley, the biggest "open library" in Saudi Arabia is nestled in a stunning desert landscape, delightfully soaked in the sunlight. Dadan served as a rest stop for various groups of people traveling by caravan, and one piece of evidence that confirms AlUla's status as a meeting point for different cultures is Jabal Ikmah. Those who passed through AlUla would visit Jabal Ikmah to leave their inscriptions and offerings. The numerous inscriptions and carvings on the cliff faces and rocks at Jabal Ikmah ensured that it would be remembered for generations to come. Please be aware that for sightseeing tours on Herga and Dadan & ikmah, you will be accompanied by a local tour guide and a small group of locals.

short_description: Jabal Sawda: Discovering the Highest Peak in Saudi Arabia. Jabal Al Akhdar: A Must-Visit Destination for Nature Enthusiasts. El Sahab Park: A Hidden Gem in the Heart of the Desert.
full_description:
Discover the rich history of Abha with one of the finest historical tours available. We will take you on an unforgettable journey through time, showcasing the magnificent heritage of the area. Our Abha city tour guarantees excitement throughout, ensuring you experience the very best that Abha has to offer.

The tour will begin at Jabal Sawda, a stunning scenic viewpoint situated 3000 meters above sea level. From this point, you can bask in the serene beauty of the misty mountains and lush green surroundings. A 20-25 minute cable car ride will take you over the hills and through the clouds, offering a breathtaking bird's eye view of the area that you can capture and cherish.

Afterwards, proceed with your Abha excursion to El Sahab Park for an opportunity to appreciate another breathtaking view of Abha that captivates numerous travelers immediately. The mountains enveloped in clouds will present the most awe-inspiring sight that will leave you astonished. If time permits, consider indulging in a meal at a nearby restaurant (optional) for a one-of-a-kind dining experience amidst the clouds.

Next, the city tour will include a visit to the renowned Shada Castle, a mud-walled structure that serves as a museum and offers a valuable insight into the local culture. The museum showcases a wide range of handicrafts and domestic objects, providing a fascinating glimpse into the lifestyle of the region.

Go visit Muftaha Village, the top destination in Saudi Arabia to immerse yourself in the traditions and culture of Asir. Witness the locals' craftsmanship as they construct houses using mud and stones, and indulge in the enchanting architectural and cultural aspects of the region. Before returning to your hotel, don't miss the opportunity to marvel at the breathtaking beauty of Jabal Al Akhdar, also known as The Green Mountain, where the entire mountain is illuminated with vibrant green lights.

short_description: Experience the key attractions of the lively coastal city of Dammam on a half-day guided tour with a small group. Take in the architectural beauty of the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture.
full_description: Your tour leader/driver will be waiting for you with a sign bearing your name, so you won't have to search for them - they will find you. They will give you their full attention throughout the tour. Once in the car, they will provide information about the sights along the way and other interesting aspects of your tour. Begin your excursion by stopping at the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra), which towers 90 meters above the desert in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. This center, also known as Ithra, was constructed by Saudi Aramco and inaugurated by King Salman bin Abdulaziz in 2016. Next, visit The Alfan Sharqy Urban Art Exhibit in Bayoniya, Al Khobar, which showcases graffiti by young Saudi artists who transformed the historic neighborhood of Bayoniya into a colorful display of street art. After that, head to the Taybeen Museum in Al Khobar, a 300-square-meter space filled with retro toys, games, and other memorabilia collected by Majid Al Ghamdi. Finally, visit the Heritage Village in Dammam, a five-story building housing a museum and a market selling traditional crafts and food. After exploring these attractions, you will be driven back to your hotel in Dammam in comfort.

short_description: Medina is famous for its numerous sacred and cultural landmarks, but visiting many of them in one day necessitates thorough preparation and organization.
full_description: Madinah Munawwarah, also known as Medina al-Munawwarah, is the second holiest city for Muslims after Mecca. It is home to Masjid-e-Nabawi, where Muhammad's tomb is situated. Located 210 miles north of Mecca and approximately 120 miles from the Red Sea coast, our tour will begin by picking you up from your designated location and visiting Masjid-e-Quba, the first mosque built by Muslims. The Masjid-e-Nabwi was built by the Prophet (ﷺ) when he moved to Madinah. It is the second most important mosque in Islam and the second largest in the world, after the Masjid al-Haram in Makkah. The Masjid al-Qiblatayn in Medina holds historical significance for Muslims as it is where the direction of prayer (Qiblah) was changed from Jerusalem to Mecca by the Islamic prophet Muhammad, leading to the entire congregation following suit under the guidance of a companion. Masjid Quba, located in the outskirts of Medina, Saudi Arabia, was the first mosque built by Muslims. Originally situated in the village of Quba, the mosque is now part of Medina after the city expanded. Admission to the mosque is free, and it is a significant site for Muslims. Jannatul Baqi, the main cemetery in Madinah, is where many of the Prophet Muhammad's close family members, companions, and other respected figures are buried. In front of the iconic Uhad Mountain lies the grave of Hamzah, the Prophet's Uncle, known as the Masters of Martyrs and Lion of Islam, whose bravery is celebrated as unparalleled. This part of Mount Uhud was the scene of the Battle of Uhud in 3 AH in Islam. The Prophet (ﷺ) said that this mountain loves them and they love it. Our next stop will be the Garden of Salman Farsi, where Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) planted three hundred date palms to free Salman Farsi from slavery. This garden is close to Masjid Quba. Another attraction is Masjid Ghamama, located about 300m south-west of Masjid-e-Nabwi. It is where the Prophet (ﷺ) performed the Eid salah in his later years. This mosque is near Gate 6 of Masjid e Nababi and Masjid Al Ghamamah, and has a single dome and is smaller in size. The Masjid Jummah, located on the outskirts of Madinah, is the place where the Prophet (ﷺ) led the first Friday prayer after migrating from Makkah. It is situated around 2.5 km away from Masjid-e-Nabwi. Around one hundred Muslims took part in this initial Friday prayer, including the Prophet's (ﷺ) relatives from Bani an-Najjar and some individuals from Bani Amr who had accompanied him from Quba. Following the prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) mounted his camel, Qaswa, and made his way to the city of Madinah. The Seven Mosques, also known as Sab'u Masajid, is a group of six historic mosques in Medina, Saudi Arabia, despite its name implying seven mosques. This group originally included Masjid al-Qiblatayn. The area is known for the land where the Prophet (ﷺ) planted three hundred date palms to free Salman Farsi (may Allah be pleased with him) from slavery, located near Masjid Quba. Visit malls then return hotel.

short_description: Experience the Fascinating History of Alula on an Exclusive Guided Tour. Discover the Ancient Carved Tombs of Hegra with a Knowledgeable Guide.
full_description: Your tour leader/driver will be there to meet you, holding a sign with your name. You don't have to search for them as they will be waiting for you and will approach you. Throughout your tour, your tour leader will be fully focused on you. Once you're in the car, your tour leader will discuss various topics, including the sights along the way and other interesting aspects of your tour. Begin your tour by visiting Hegra, also called Madain Saleh or Al-Ḥijr, which is an archaeological site situated in the AlUla area of Al Madinah Region in Hejaz, Saudi Arabia. The majority of the remaining structures date back to the Nabatean kingdom and make up the biggest and southernmost settlement following Petra, the capital. This site, previously known as Hegra, is the largest preserved location of the Nabataeans' civilization south of Jordan's Petra. It boasts well-maintained monumental tombs featuring adorned facades that range from the 1st century BC to the 1st century AD. Additionally, it is worth noting that the Archaeological Site of Al-Hijr (Madain Saleh) is Saudi Arabia's first World Heritage property. Next, you can experience the beauty of Elephant Rock, a breathtaking natural formation that bears a striking resemblance to an elephant, with its trunk gracefully reaching the ground. This particular wonder of nature has become an iconic landmark in AlUla, and is also referred to as Jabal AlFil, among the numerous geological marvels in the region.

title: Supply Partner |
short_description: Enjoy a thrilling day with camel rides, sandboarding, ATV safari, and parasailing over azure waters. Visit a Bedouin tent, and savor a delicious barbecue lunch, all in one exciting adventure
full_description:
Your Sharm El Sheikh adventure starts with hotel pickup at 8:00 AM, where you’ll meet your representative. You’ll then travel in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle to the ATV station in the Sinai Desert. After a safety briefing and helmet fitting, you'll set off on a thrilling quad bike ride through the desert's multi-colored sands. You'll stop for photos and enjoy the vast desert landscapes, with a chance to experience the eco-sound phenomenon in the mountains, where your voice echoes off the rocky cliffs.

Following your ATV ride, you’ll head to a traditional Bedouin village for an authentic experience of desert life. Enjoy a peaceful camel ride across the desert, then try sandboarding down the dunes. Afterward, relax in a desert tent, where you’ll enjoy traditional Bedouin tea and learn about their way of life.

Next, you'll head to the marina for an exciting parasailing adventure. After a safety briefing, you'll soar above the Red Sea for panoramic views of the coastline and desert. Your parasailing flight will last about 10 minutes, offering unforgettable aerial views.

Then, enjoy thrilling banana boat and tube rides on the waves. These fun, high-energy activities will add an adrenaline boost to your day. Afterward, you’ll be treated to a delicious lunch with traditional Egyptian dishes like grilled meats, falafel, and salads.

Following lunch, embark on a relaxing glass boat ride, where you can view the vibrant coral reefs and colorful fish of the Red Sea through the boat's glass bottom. This peaceful experience provides a calm end to your action-packed day.

Finally, you’ll be transferred back to your hotel, filled with memories of a day that combined adventure, relaxation, and cultural immersion. This tour is the perfect mix of desert exploration, thrilling water activities, and authentic local experiences.

short_description: Discover the Sharm el-Sheikh Museum with an entry ticket and convenient hotel transfer. See artifacts like the Wife of Nakhtmin statue, mummies, and the sculpture heads of Hatshepsut and Thutmose.
full_description:
Pre-book your entry ticket to the Sharm el-Sheikh Museum and see the vast collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts housed within its walls. Benefit from a convenient private hotel transfer to and from the museum.




Start with pickup from your hotel in a private vehicle. Then, travel directly to the Sharm El Sheikh Museum and enter with your pre-reserved ticket.




Wander through the museum’s Grand Hall which presents a history of humans and wildlife in ancient Egypt, and highlights ancient Egyptian civilization’s preoccupation with science, mathematics, industry, crafts, family life, and reverence for animals.




See notable treasures such as the Wife of Nakhtmin statue, Hathor's capital, and the sculptural heads of Hatshepsut and Thutmose. In the Hall of Civilization admire the beautiful inner and outer coffins of Isetemheb, the wife of the high-priest of Amun Panedjem II. 




After you finish your exploration of the museum, you will meet your driver in front of the museum to journey back to your accommodation.
highlights: Explore Sharm el-Sheikh Museum's collection
Learn about ancient Egyptian civilization and culture
Admire various artifacts found near the city
See ornately decorated coffins and caskets
Benefit from a convenient private hotel transfer

short_description: A one-way private hotel transfer to and from Sharm El-Sheikh Airport (SSH) provides a convenient and comfortable travel experience.
full_description:
A one-way private hotel transfer to and from Sharm El-Sheikh Airport (SSH) provides a convenient and comfortable travel experience. Typically, this service is available for both arrival and departure and ensures that you can avoid the hassle of public transportation or taxis. Here's what you can expect from such a transfer

Arrival Transfer (From SSH to Hotel):
Pickup: A driver will be waiting for you at the airport, usually in the arrival hall, holding a sign with your name on it.
Comfort: You will travel in a private vehicle, often a sedan or minivan, depending on your group size.
Direct Journey: The transfer is direct, taking you straight to your hotel.
Duration: The journey from Sharm El-Sheikh Airport to most hotels in the city typically takes about 20–40 minutes, depending on the hotel’s location.

Departure Transfer (From Hotel to SSH):
Pickup: The driver will pick you up from your hotel at the scheduled time, ensuring you arrive at the airport with plenty of time before your flight.
Comfort: As with the arrival transfer, you’ll travel in a private vehicle.
Timely Service: You will be driven directly to the airport.
Duration: The journey back to SSH Airport is usually around the same 20–40 minutes.

A one-way private hotel transfer between Sharm El-Sheikh Airport (SSH) and your hotel offers a convenient, reliable, and stress-free way to travel in and out of the city. With a driver who meets you at the airport or your hotel, you can enjoy a direct, comfortable, and efficient transfer to your destination. This service provides several benefits, including personalized service, privacy, and flexibility, making it a popular choice for travelers who want to avoid the hassle of traditional transport options. Whether you're heading to your hotel after a long flight or catching your return flight, booking a private transfer ensures a smooth and enjoyable travel experience.

Our representative will pick you up from your hotel in an air-conditioned car and then head to Albatros Aqua Park, the largest water park complex in Sharm El-Sheikh. Enjoy a day of excitement at Albatros Aqua Park Sharm El-Sheikh with a wide range of water slides, pools, and games to choose from.

Spend the day relaxing at the Aqua Park, Egypt’s biggest water park, in Sharm el-Sheikh. Choose from two ticket options: tickets only or an all-inclusive pass with food and transfers. After the day, our agent will transport you back to the hotel in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle. Relax and reminisce about the memories you made throughout the day during your journey back.

short_description: you will be able to explore the wonders of the deep space, the stars,planets, and the amazing sky of Sharm El-Sheikh after sunset with professional Astronomers' knowledge of the space world
full_description:
At The First You will be picked up from your Hotel to the safari station With an air-conditioned Van You will be received there by your guides and companions for the trip They will provide a quick explanation of the trip instructions, Then they will help you wrap the scarf and they will let you know how to drive a ATV - BUGGY.
When riding a motorcycle or buggy, please leave your belongings in your bag, such as money, mobile phone, and personal papers (Passports).
Then we will start driving and start the trip, The driving time is 50 minutes, including 2 breaks - The first break to enjoy the echo of the sound in the giant mountains
2- The second break is at a Bedouin camp for Bedouin tea , Riding a camel with a panoramic view of the mountains
Then we will move to another Bedouin camp, where we have there a show, party and a (BBQ Bedouin dinner), and our Shows included : the fire man, the Tanura Show, and the Bedouin dance. See and taste Bedouin bread
(Bedouin dinner) : grilled meat with kofta, chicken, rice, vegetables and salads with Cola.
Then move to watch the stars and planets with astronomical telescopes
Then return to the safari station by driving for 30 minutes at night
Air-conditioned cars will be waiting there to take you to the hotel.

short_description: Travel from Sharm El-Sheikh to Cairo by bus to see the Great Pyramids and Sphinx. Explore the Egyptian Museum and Khan El Khalili Bazaar, and return by flight.
full_description:
Hotel Pickup and Transfer: Your adventure begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel in Sharm El-Sheikh. Our driver will transfer you to the airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival in Cairo, another driver will be waiting for you outside the airport. You'll receive the driver's details after booking to ensure easy contact.

Pyramids of Giza and Great Sphinx: Start your exciting day in Cairo with a visit to the iconic Pyramids of Giza and the majestic Great Sphinx. Accompanied by an expert Egyptologist guide, you'll have the opportunity to ride a camel and capture unforgettable photos with the breathtaking pyramids in the background.

Egyptian Museum: Next, immerse yourself in history at the world-famous Egyptian Museum, the oldest archaeological museum in the Middle East. Marvel at the largest collection of Pharaonic treasures, with artifacts spanning from the Predynastic Period to the Greco-Roman Era.

Lunch: After the museum, enjoy a relaxing stop for a delicious lunch at a local restaurant, where you can savor authentic Egyptian cuisine.

Khan El Khalili Bazaar: Following lunch, explore the vibrant Khan El Khalili Bazaar, one of Cairo's most famous and historic markets. Stroll through its lively streets, where the rich culture and unique souvenirs make it a must-see destination.

Return Flight and Hotel Transfer: At the end of this unforgettable tour, you'll be transferred back to Cairo Airport for your return flight to Sharm El-Sheikh. Upon arrival, our driver will be waiting to take you back to your hotel.

In Sharm el Sheikh, we will pick you from your accommodation at your hotel. Our bus is equipped with air conditioning for your comfort. We will then transport you to a location around 20 minutes away, where you will have the opportunity to drive sand buggies. You will receive a short instructional session on how to operate the vehicles safely before the excitement and enjoyment begins.

We will offer you a knowledgeable guide who will accompany you to explore the awe-inspiring landscapes of the stunning South Sinai desert. This is the perfect opportunity for you to fully enjoy the vastness of the desert by speeding through it.

While on the journey, you will make a pause to savor the delightful Egyptian tea served at a Bedouin tent, and witness the breathtaking sunset, which depends on the departure time.

You can choose to ride a single sand buggy or share it with another person.

The sand buggies provided are equipped with seatbelts and specifically designed to handle the desert terrain, making it a safe option for children as well.

short_description: Join a day trip from Sharm El Sheikh to the Colored Canyon, Blue Hole, and Dahab. Explore vibrant rock formations, snorkel in colorful reefs, and enjoy a delicious BBQ lunch in a Bedouin tent
full_description:
Discover two stunning wonders of the Sinai Peninsula in one exhilarating day on our jeep tour to the Colored Canyon and Blue Hole National Park, departing from Sharm El Sheikh. This unforgettable adventure begins with an early morning pickup in a comfortable, air-conditioned vehicle, taking you on a scenic journey to the charming town of Dahab.

First, embark on a jeep ride to the iconic Colored Canyon. Wander through a mesmerizing 800-meter gorge filled with vibrant sandstone cliffs displaying shades of yellow, purple, red, and gold. This natural labyrinth promises breathtaking views at every turn.

Next, visit the serene Blue Hole National Park, where you can relax on the beach and experience exceptional snorkeling among an array of colorful coral reefs and marine life. Dive into an underwater paradise teeming with vibrant fish and unique species.

After a day of exploration, enjoy a delicious BBQ lunch at the beach camp, surrounded by stunning views of the sea and mountains. Take a moment to breathe in the fresh air before embarking on a camel ride along the coast, capturing memorable photos along the way.

Your adventure continues with an adrenaline-pumping quad bike ride along Dahab's coastline. Feel the rush as you navigate the scenic terrain, making the most of your time in this beautiful region.

Finally, return by jeep to Dahab City for a brief shopping stop, where you can pick up unique souvenirs before concluding your tour back in Sharm El Sheikh. Join us for a day of natural beauty, adventure, and unforgettable memories!

short_description: Experience a thrilling adventure in Sharm El-Sheikh. Enjoy ATV/buggy rides, go sandboarding, ride a camel, and have a delicious Bedouin breakfast and authentic Bedouin tea.
full_description:
At 9 Am. you will be picked up from your hotel in Sharm El-Sheikh Embark on an unforgettable adventure in Sharm El-Sheikh with this thrilling ATV Quad & Buggy Adventure. This exciting morning tour, lasting around 3 hours, allows you to explore the majestic desert landscapes while enjoying an array of fun activities.

Your adventure begins with a safety briefing where you’ll be given the necessary instructions to ride your ATV quad or buggy through the stunning terrain. Once you’re ready, hit the desert trails, driving through sand dunes, rocky paths, and rugged mountains. The fun of off-roading through the vast desert is a truly unique experience.

After the adrenaline-filled ride, you'll head to a traditional **Bedouin village** where you'll enjoy a **delicious Bedouin breakfast**. Treat yourself to freshly baked flatbread, local cheeses, olives, fresh juice, and Bedouin tea, while taking in the beautiful desert surroundings.

To make the experience even more memorable, try your hand at **sandboarding** down the dunes, gliding across the sand for an extra rush of excitement. Next, enjoy a peaceful **camel ride** through the desert, offering a serene and unique perspective of the landscape.

Relax with a cup of **Bedouin tea** before concluding the adventure, feeling refreshed and energized after your desert exploration.

This tour combines culture, adventure, and tradition, making it an unforgettable way to experience the beauty of **Sharm El-Sheikh**.

full_description:
Ras Mohammed & White Island Boat Trip – A South Sinai Adventure
Set off on an unforgettable journey to the southernmost tip of South Sinai, where breathtaking landscapes meet crystal-clear waters. This all-day adventure combines relaxation, exploration, and a taste of Egypt’s natural beauty.
Seamless Start to Your Day
Begin your trip with a comfortable hotel pickup and head to the marina, where your boat awaits. As you sail toward Ras Mohammed National Park, soak in panoramic views of the Red Sea’s turquoise waters.
White Island & Ras Mohammed Exploration
Cruise to the iconic White Island, a natural sandbar where the Gulfs of Suez and Aqaba meet. Stroll along the gleaming shoreline and take in this unique geographical wonder.
At Ras Mohammed, dive into adventure with two snorkeling stops at some of the world’s most vibrant coral reefs, home to brilliant marine life and colorful tropical fish.
Delicious Onboard Lunch
Recharge with a freshly prepared barbecue lunch featuring rice, pasta, salads, and chicken, served right on deck as you enjoy the Red Sea breeze.
Relaxation & Return
After your snorkeling adventure, unwind on the sundeck as you cruise back, capturing the stunning coastal views of Sharm El Sheikh.
Upon arrival at the marina, your driver will transfer you back to your hotel, ending a day filled with natural wonders, vibrant reefs, and memories to last a lifetime.

Have the opportunity to go snorkeling in Egypt's most beautiful reef. Marvel at a remarkably colorful underwater world. Mangroves are the only trees that grow in saltwater. In the Ras Mohammed National Park, you can find these unique trees that are actually native to Central Africa.

Discover the Magic Lake, a large deep lake suitable for swimming. The Bedouin gave his name to the magic lake and you will learn fantastic stories about him. After your snorkeling experience at the Ras Mohammed National Park, be returned to your accommodation .
