short_description: A wonderful sea trip by a luxury boat to the charming White Island and the National Park of Ras Mohamed. Have a great snorkeling activity on the best spots. Enjoy lunch on boat and transfer.
full_description:
Explore the breathtaking waters of the Red Sea on this boat tour to Ras Mohamed National Park and White Island. Cruise out from Sharm El Sheikh Marina and enjoy the fresh sea breeze, crystal-clear waters, and a delicious barbecue lunch served on board.

Get picked up from your hotel and transferred to the marina in Sharm El Sheikh. Jump aboard the yacht and set sail for Ras Mohamed National Park, on the southernmost tip of the Sinai peninsula. Stop here to explore the area’s vibrant coral reef with a professional guide.

Optionally, you can choose to rent snorkeling or dive gear to see more of the reef.

Continue to the stunning White Island, where you can snorkel in the surrounding shallow waters, relax on the soft sand and take photos of the sparkling Red Sea. Back on board, enjoy a delicious lunch of rice, pasta, salads, barbeque chicken.

After you return to the marina, you’ll be dropped back at your hotel.

short_description: Experience the Magic of the Desert Sky
full_description:
Stargazing Experience with VIP BBQ Dinner, Camel Ride & Bedouin Show
Discover the magic of the Sinai Desert with our all-inclusive luxury stargazing adventure — a night filled with culture, cuisine, and celestial beauty!
Relax with comfortable, air-conditioned transportation to and from your hotel in Sharm El-Sheikh. Embrace the spirit of the desert as you enjoy a gentle camel ride across golden sands, just like the Bedouins. Savor a rich selection of grilled meats, fresh salads, oriental dishes, and traditional Bedouin bread — all served buffet-style in a cozy desert camp with panoramic mountain views. Enjoy with soft drinks and a seasonal fruit platter to complement your meal under the stars. Once darkness falls, gaze deep into the night sky through high-powered telescopes. Our expert guides will walk you through the constellations and share fascinating astronomical stories. Be entertained by a vibrant Tanoura dance, mesmerizing fire show, and authentic Bedouin music that brings the desert to life. Take in the breathtaking natural beauty of the Sinai Desert and surrounding mountains, perfect for stunning photos and unforgettable memories. Experience the wonder of the night sky with a 30-minute guided stargazing session. Use professional telescopes to explore distant planets, stars, and constellations, all while learning fascinating facts from an expert astronomer.

short_description: Enjoy a magical sound and light show at the Giza Pyramids with a delicious dinner and stunning night views. A unique blend of history, lights, and flavors awaits you!
full_description:
Enjoy an unforgettable evening at the foot of the majestic Giza Pyramids with this immersive sound and light show experience, paired with a delicious dinner. Your evening begins with convenient hotel pickup and a comfortable transfer to a premium rooftop or garden restaurant with direct views of the illuminated pyramids. As the sun sets and the sky darkens, savor a carefully prepared dinner featuring traditional Egyptian cuisine in a unique and atmospheric setting.

After dinner, watch the pyramids come alive during the world-renowned sound and light show. Through captivating narration and dazzling light projections, the show tells the story of ancient Egypt, its legendary pharaohs, and the wonders of the Giza Plateau. The Sphinx acts as the narrator, guiding you through thousands of years of history in an unforgettable performance.

This experience is ideal for couples, families, and anyone wanting to enjoy Cairo’s ancient landmarks in a magical and relaxed setting. After the show, your driver will transfer you comfortably back to your hotel.
highlights: Learn the Egyptian history from the sound and light show
Enjoy your dinner with a unique view of the great pyramids
See the pyramids and Sphinx illuminated against the desert sands

short_description: Capture iconic shots at the Giza Pyramids, enjoy a camel ride, and snap colorful photos in Khan El Khalili bazaar. Includes lunch, private guide, and hotel pickup for a photo-perfect day.
full_description:
Get your camera ready for a picture-perfect private tour that captures the magic of Cairo! Begin your day with a comfortable hotel pickup in a modern, air-conditioned vehicle as you head to the legendary Giza Plateau.
With your expert private guide, explore the Great Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure from the best photo angles. Enjoy a short camel ride near the pyramids—an unforgettable photo moment with the desert backdrop and ancient wonders behind you.
Afterwards, dive into the heart of Old Cairo with a visit to Khan El Khalili, one of the oldest and most photogenic markets in the Middle East. Wander through vibrant alleys filled with spices, lanterns, and handcrafted treasures. Your guide will help you find the most scenic spots and hidden gems for iconic shots.
Throughout the tour, you'll have plenty of time to pause for photos and enjoy the atmosphere without rushing.
Enjoy a traditional Egyptian lunch at a handpicked local restaurant before being comfortably dropped off at your hotel.
Whether you're a casual traveler or a social media enthusiast, this tour is crafted to give you unforgettable memories and frame-worthy moments—all with the comfort, privacy, and personal attention you deserve.

Dine at a local restaurant and savor authentic Egyptian cuisine

short_description: Experience the perfect mix of adventure, culture, and luxury with this VIP tour of Giza. Discover authentic organic oils and Egyptian scarves from FTS for an unforgettable journey!
full_description:
Exclusive VIP Tour: Pyramids, ATV, Camel Ride & Bazaar

Start your luxury journey with a private, air-conditioned vehicle pickup from your hotel in Cairo. Relax as you are driven to the Giza Plateau, where your expert Egyptologist guide will lead your exclusive exploration of Egypt's iconic landmarks.

Explore the Giza Plateau

Visit the majestic Pyramids of Giza: The Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, and the Pyramid of Menkaure. Learn about their history, construction, and significance.

Marvel at the Sphinx: Unravel fascinating stories about this mysterious monument with the body of a lion and the head of a pharaoh.


Adventure Activities

ATV Ride: Experience the excitement of riding an ATV across the sand dunes around the pyramids, offering unique views of these ancient wonders and the vast desert landscape.

Camel Ride: Immerse yourself in the timeless tradition of camel riding, enjoying breathtaking views of the pyramids from this elevated vantage point.


Capture the Moments

Take unforgettable photos with the pyramids as your backdrop, creating lasting memories of this extraordinary experience.

Visit a Traditional Bazaar

Stroll through a vibrant Egyptian market to shop for souvenirs, local crafts, and traditional products. Let your guide assist you in navigating the stalls and bargaining for the best deals while soaking in the market's lively atmosphere.
